title: An ideal suspect: atrial flutter unmasked by implantable cardioverter defibrillator interrogation.
Predictive value of systemic inflammatory indices for new-onset atrial fibrillation after acute myocardial infarction: an interpretable machine learning study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: New-onset atrial fibrillation (NOAF) after acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is associated with adverse outcomes. Inflammation contributes to atrial fibrillation (AF) onset and progression. We developed an interpretable machine learning (ML) framework integrating complete blood count (CBC)-derived inflammatory indices with routine clinical parameters for NOAF risk assessment.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 3,077 AMI patients without prior AF (2018-2023). Multivariable logistic regression, restricted cubic splines (RCS), and threshold analyses evaluated six inflammatory indices: neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), systemic inflammation response index (SIRI), and aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI). Boruta and LASSO selections were intersected. Eight ML models were evaluated, with Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) for interpretation.

RESULTS: NOAF incidence was 7.73%. Six indices were associated with NOAF in separate adjusted models (all p < 0.05). Estimated change points were approximately 5.5 (NLR), 1217 (SII), 2.9 (SIRI), and 430 (AISI). The support vector machine (SVM) achieved the highest mean training out-of-fold (OOF) area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC; 0.357) and a held-out test PR-AUC of 0.407. Mean absolute SHAP values were highest for left atrial diameter (LAD), age, and B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP); SIRI ranked first among inflammatory features. Fixed-feature ablation showed modest PR-AUC and Brier-score improvements, uncertain ROC-AUC gains, and no consistent net benefit on decision-curve analysis.

CONCLUSIONS: CBC-derived inflammatory indices were associated with NOAF, but their incremental predictive value beyond routine clinical variables remains uncertain. Given moderate predictive performance and no external validation, multicenter validation is needed before clinical implementation.

AI.tldr: 在3077例急性心肌梗死患者中，基于血常规的炎症指数与院内新发房颤相关，但机器学习模型显示其增量预测价值有限，需外部验证。
AI.motivation: 急性心肌梗死（AMI）后新发房颤（NOAF）与不良预后相关，炎症参与房颤发生发展。既往研究多单独分析炎症指标，缺乏将其与常规临床参数整合的可解释机器学习模型，且炎症指标的增量预测价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2018-2023年3077例无房颤史的AMI患者。评估六种血常规衍生炎症指数（NLR、PLR、SII、MLR、SIRI、AISI），采用多因素logistic回归、限制性立方样条和阈值分析。通过Boruta和LASSO交叉筛选特征，构建8种机器学习模型，以Shapley加性解释（SHAP）进行模型解释。主要终点为NOAF发生率，模型性能以PR-AUC、ROC-AUC和Brier评分评估。
AI.result: NOAF发生率为7.73%。六种炎症指数在各自校正模型中均与NOAF相关（均p<0.05）。估计变化点约为NLR 5.5、SII 1217、SIRI 2.9、AISI 430。支持向量机（SVM）训练集平均折外PR-AUC最高（0.357），保留测试集PR-AUC为0.407。SHAP平均绝对值最高的特征为左房内径（LAD）、年龄和BNP；炎症特征中SIRI排名第一。固定特征消融显示PR-AUC和Brier评分改善有限，ROC-AUC增益不确定，决策曲线分析未见一致净获益。
AI.conclusion: 血常规衍生炎症指数与AMI后NOAF相关，但其在常规临床变量之外的增量预测价值仍不确定。鉴于模型预测性能中等且缺乏外部验证，临床实施前需多中心验证。

summary_zh:
背景：急性心肌梗死（AMI）后新发心房颤动（NOAF）与不良结局相关。炎症促进心房颤动（AF）的发生和进展。我们开发了一个可解释的机器学习（ML）框架，将全血细胞计数（CBC）衍生的炎症指标与常规临床参数相结合，用于NOAF风险评估。

方法：我们回顾性分析了3,077例既往无AF的AMI患者（2018-2023年）。多变量逻辑回归、限制性立方样条（RCS）和阈值分析评估了六项炎症指标：中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）、血小板与淋巴细胞比值（PLR）、全身免疫炎症指数（SII）、单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值（MLR）、全身炎症反应指数（SIRI）和全身炎症综合指数（AISI）。Boruta和LASSO选择取交集。评估了八种ML模型，并使用Shapley加法解释（SHAP）进行解释。

结果：NOAF发生率为7.73%。在各自的调整模型中，六项指标均与NOAF相关（均p < 0.05）。估计变化点约为5.5（NLR）、1217（SII）、2.9（SIRI）和430（AISI）。支持向量机（SVM）获得了最高的平均训练折外（OOF）精确率-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC；0.357）和保留测试集PR-AUC为0.407。平均绝对SHAP值最高的是左心房内径（LAD）、年龄和B型利钠肽（BNP）；SIRI在炎症特征中排名第一。固定特征消融显示PR-AUC和Brier评分有适度改善，ROC-AUC增益不确定，决策曲线分析无一致的净获益。

结论：CBC衍生的炎症指标与NOAF相关，但其在常规临床变量之外的增量预测价值仍不确定。鉴于预测性能中等且无外部验证，在临床实施前需要进行多中心验证。

title: New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Critically Ill Patients: A Systematic Review of In-Hospital and Post-Discharge Outcomes.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: This systematic review and meta-analysis determines the incidence of new-onset atrial fibrillation (NOAF) in critically ill patients, risks of post-discharge systemic thromboembolism, anticoagulation therapy, and the proportion diagnosed with AF post-discharge.

DATA SOURCES: A search of registered databases (PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and CINAHL) was performed from inception to April 20, 2026.

STUDY SELECTION: Eligible studies included critically ill patients (≥ 18 yr old) who developed NOAF during admission to general ICUs or high-dependency units. NOAF was defined as AF in patients without prior history of AF.

DATA EXTRACTION: Data were independently extracted from full-text versions of included studies by nonblinded reviewers.

DATA SYNTHESIS: A Bayesian meta-analysis was conducted on 54 studies (367,896 patients) with a random-effects model using R (Version 4.3.3). Pooled incidence of NOAF in critically ill patients was 10.6% (95% credible interval [CrI], 8.6-12.9%). Absolute risk of post-discharge systemic thromboembolism was 7.1% (95% CrI, 4.5-11.0%), changing to 6.9% (95% CrI, 4.2-11.6%) after age and sex adjustment. Evidence from six studies reports that critically ill patients with NOAF had 1.94 times (95% CrI, 1.23-3.29) higher relative risk of systemic thromboembolism post-discharge than patients without NOAF, rising to 2.01 (95% CrI, 1.54-2.80) with adjustment. Absolute and relative risk are evaluated with follow-up durations ranging from 1.5 months to 5 years, with variable anticoagulation exposure. Anticoagulation rates were low: 32.9% in-hospital (95% CrI, 14.6-57.9%) and 35.9% post-discharge (95% CrI, 19.7-55.9%). On follow-up, 23.9% (95% CrI, 13.9-38.5%) of critically ill patients with NOAF were subsequently diagnosed with AF.

CONCLUSIONS: Our review suggests that NOAF during critical illness is associated with significantly increased risk of post-discharge systemic thromboembolism and subsequent AF diagnosis. However, rates of anticoagulation initiation remain low, highlighting the need for improved risk stratification and targeted strategies post-discharge.

AI.tldr: 重症患者新发房颤（NOAF）发生率约10.6%，出院后系统性血栓栓塞风险较无NOAF者近2倍，但抗凝治疗率仅约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 重症患者住院期间新发房颤（NOAF）常见，但其出院后系统性血栓栓塞风险、抗凝治疗现状及后续房颤诊断比例尚缺乏系统量化证据，既往研究多为单中心、样本量有限，难以指导出院后管理策略。
AI.method: 系统综述与贝叶斯荟萃分析。检索PubMed、Embase、Scopus、CINAHL自建库至2026年4月20日。纳入标准为≥18岁、入住综合ICU或高依赖病房期间发生NOAF（既往无房颤史）的重症患者。共纳入54项研究、367,896例患者，采用随机效应模型（R 4.3.3）合并估计发生率、绝对风险与相对风险，随访时间1.5个月至5年，抗凝暴露情况不一。
AI.result: NOAF合并发生率为10.6%（95%CrI 8.6-12.9%）。出院后系统性血栓栓塞绝对风险7.1%（95%CrI 4.5-11.0%），年龄性别校正后6.9%（95%CrI 4.2-11.6%）。6项研究显示NOAF患者出院后系统性血栓栓塞相对风险为无NOAF者的1.94倍（95%CrI 1.23-3.29），校正后2.01（95%CrI 1.54-2.80）。抗凝率偏低：住院期间32.9%（95%CrI 14.6-57.9%），出院后35.9%（95%CrI 19.7-55.9%）。随访中23.9%（95%CrI 13.9-38.5%）的NOAF患者后续被诊断为房颤。
AI.conclusion: 重症期间NOAF与出院后系统性血栓栓塞及后续房颤诊断风险显著升高相关，但抗凝启动率仍低。提示需完善出院后风险分层与针对性管理策略；局限性包括随访时长与抗凝暴露异质性大、观察性证据为主，NOAF患者是否应常规抗凝尚需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在确定危重症患者中新发心房颤动（NOAF）的发生率、出院后系统性血栓栓塞的风险、抗凝治疗情况以及出院后诊断为AF的比例。

数据来源：对注册数据库（PubMed、Embase、Scopus和CINAHL）进行了从建库至2026年4月20日的检索。

研究选择：纳入的研究包括在普通ICU或高依赖病房住院期间发生NOAF的危重症患者（≥18岁）。NOAF定义为既往无AF病史的患者出现AF。

数据提取：由非盲法评价者独立从纳入研究的全文版本中提取数据。

数据合成：使用R（版本4.3.3）对54项研究（367,896例患者）采用随机效应模型进行贝叶斯荟萃分析。危重症患者NOAF的合并发生率为10.6%（95%可信区间[CrI]，8.6-12.9%）。出院后系统性血栓栓塞的绝对风险为7.1%（95% CrI，4.5-11.0%），经年龄和性别调整后变为6.9%（95% CrI，4.2-11.6%）。来自六项研究的证据报告，发生NOAF的危重症患者出院后系统性血栓栓塞的相对风险是未发生NOAF患者的1.94倍（95% CrI，1.23-3.29），经调整后升至2.01（95% CrI，1.54-2.80）。绝对和相对风险的评估随访时间为1.5个月至5年，抗凝暴露情况不一。抗凝治疗率较低：住院期间为32.9%（95% CrI，14.6-57.9%），出院后为35.9%（95% CrI，19.7-55.9%）。随访时，23.9%（95% CrI，13.9-38.5%）的危重症NOAF患者随后被诊断为AF。

结论：本综述提示，危重症期间发生的NOAF与出院后系统性血栓栓塞风险及后续AF诊断风险显著增加相关。然而，启动抗凝治疗的比例仍然较低，凸显了改进风险分层和出院后针对性策略的必要性。

title: The Impact of Energy Drinks on the Genesis of Cardiac Arrhythmias: A Narrative Review.
summary: This narrative review aims to synthesize research on energy drink use and the development of arrhythmias among healthy individuals without preexisting conditions. A special focus is given to the electrocardiogram (EKG) following beverage consumption. A literature search was conducted on the Web of Science, Embase, Medline, and Cochrane databases for original, peer-reviewed studies that reported EKG findings following energy drink consumption. Secondary research and studies that had subjects with preexisting cardiac conditions were excluded. Ten controlled experimental studies and seven case reports met the inclusion criteria. Currently available evidence from controlled experimental studies involved one-time, one-day intake of energy drinks. Beverages varied in volume, content, and consumption rates across studies. Some acute EKG changes, including prolongation of the corrected QT (QTc) interval, have been reported in prospective studies in relation to energy drinks. However, no clinically significant arrhythmias were recorded. Although the studies in this review suggest that limited use of energy drinks is unlikely to cause an arrhythmia in healthy individuals, their arrhythmogenic potential cannot be ruled out. Case reports related to otherwise healthy individuals demonstrate a potential relationship between energy drink usage and the development of atrial fibrillation, especially with the co-ingestion of alcohol. The presence of confounding factors in these case reports makes it unclear whether energy drinks alone, or with the presence of additional triggers, may precipitate an arrhythmia. Future research should focus on energy drink use over time and on the contribution of lifestyle factors to better assess the impact of energy drinks on arrhythmia genesis.

AI.tldr: 健康人群单次饮用能量饮料可致QTc间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常；病例报告提示能量饮料（尤其与酒精同服）可能与房颤发生相关。
AI.motivation: 能量饮料消费日益普遍，但其对健康人群心律失常发生的影响尚不明确，既往证据多集中于已有心脏疾病者，缺乏对无基础疾病人群心电图变化的系统总结。
AI.method: 叙述性综述。检索Web of Science、Embase、Medline和Cochrane数据库，纳入报告能量饮料消费后心电图结局的原创同行评议研究，排除二次研究及受试者有基础心脏疾病的研究。最终纳入10项对照实验研究和7例病例报告。
AI.result: 对照实验研究均涉及单次、单日能量饮料摄入，饮料体积、成分和饮用速度各异。前瞻性研究报告了一些急性心电图改变，包括校正QT（QTc）间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常。病例报告提示，平素健康个体饮用能量饮料与房颤发生存在潜在关联，尤其在与酒精同服时；但混杂因素使能量饮料单独或与其他触发因素共同作用尚不明确。
AI.conclusion: 有限使用能量饮料在健康个体中不太可能引起心律失常，但其致心律失常潜力不能排除，尤其与酒精同服时。未来需研究长期饮用及生活方式因素的影响，以更好评估能量饮料在心律失常发生中的作用。

summary_zh: 本叙述性综述旨在综合关于能量饮料使用与无基础疾病的健康个体发生心律失常的研究。特别关注饮用饮料后的心电图（EKG）。在Web of Science、Embase、Medline和Cochrane数据库上进行了文献检索，寻找报告饮用能量饮料后EKG结果的原创、同行评审研究。排除二次研究以及受试者有基础心脏疾病的研究。十项对照实验研究和七项病例报告符合纳入标准。目前来自对照实验研究的证据涉及一次性、单日摄入能量饮料。各研究中饮料的体积、成分和饮用速度各不相同。一些急性EKG变化，包括校正QT（QTc）间期延长，已在前瞻性研究中报告与能量饮料相关。然而，未记录到有临床意义的心律失常。尽管本综述中的研究表明，有限使用能量饮料不太可能在健康个体中引起心律失常，但不能排除其致心律失常潜力。与原本健康个体相关的病例报告显示，能量饮料使用与心房颤动的发生之间存在潜在关系，尤其是与酒精共同摄入时。这些病例报告中存在混杂因素，使得不清楚是单独的能量饮料还是存在额外触发因素可能诱发心律失常。未来的研究应关注能量饮料的长期使用以及生活方式因素的贡献，以更好地评估能量饮料对心律失常发生的影响。

title: Sex differences in atrial fibrillation incidence among individuals with metabolic syndrome: a narrative mini review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sex differences influence the development and clinical expression of many chronic cardiometabolic diseases. Atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common sustained arrhythmia, frequently coexists with metabolic syndrome (MetS), yet whether MetS confers different AF risk in men and women remains incompletely understood.

CONTENT: Epidemiological evidence consistently demonstrates that MetS increases the risk of incident AF by approximately 1.4- to 1.9-fold. Among MetS components, elevated blood pressure and abdominal obesity show the strongest associations with AF onset. Most studies also reveal that men have higher rates of AF than women across all age groups, although AF incidence in women rises sharply after menopause. In individuals with MetS, similar sex-related trends are observed: men typically exhibit a higher and earlier AF incidence, whereas women experience a delayed but steep increase in older age.Biological differences-particularly sex hormone-driven variations in fat distribution, lipid metabolism, insulin sensitivity, and inflammation-may underlie these patterns. Premenopausal women tend to accumulate subcutaneous, metabolically benign fat, whereas men preferentially store visceral fat, promoting earlier metabolic dysfunction and AF susceptibility. After menopause, declining estrogen levels shift women toward central adiposity and cardiometabolic deterioration, narrowing the AF incidence gap. Sex-related differences in autonomic balance and adiposity-related sympathetic activation may further modulate AF risk.

CONCLUSION: While MetS increases AF risk in both sexes, accumulating evidence suggests that the magnitude, timing, and underlying mechanisms of this risk differ between men and women. Better integration of sex-specific biological pathways into AF prevention strategies is warranted.

AI.tldr: 代谢综合征使男女房颤风险均增加约1.4-1.9倍，但男性发病更早更高，女性绝经后风险陡增，机制涉及性激素驱动的脂肪分布与代谢差异。
AI.motivation: 代谢综合征（MetS）与房颤（AF）常共存，但MetS对男女AF风险的影响是否不同尚不完全清楚，既往证据未充分整合性别特异性生物学通路。
AI.method: 叙述性小型综述，汇总流行病学证据，探讨MetS及其组分与 incident AF 的关联，并分析性别差异（发病率、发病时机）及潜在机制（性激素、脂肪分布、脂代谢、胰岛素敏感性、炎症、自主神经平衡）。未报告系统检索策略、样本量或定量合并分析。
AI.result: MetS使新发AF风险增加约1.4-1.9倍；MetS组分中血压升高和腹型肥胖与AF发病关联最强。多数研究显示男性各年龄段AF发病率高于女性，但女性绝经后AF发病率急剧上升。在MetS人群中，男性AF发病更高更早，女性则发病延迟但老年期陡增。机制上，绝经前女性倾向皮下脂肪堆积（代谢良性），男性倾向内脏脂肪堆积，导致更早代谢功能障碍和AF易感性；绝经后雌激素下降使女性转向中心性肥胖和心血管代谢恶化，缩小AF发病率差距；自主神经平衡和肥胖相关交感激活的性别差异也可能调节AF风险。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: MetS增加男女AF风险，但风险幅度、时机和机制存在性别差异；应将性别特异性生物学通路更好整合进AF预防策略。对电生理实践而言，提示需关注女性绝经后代谢恶化带来的AF风险上升，但本综述为叙述性，缺乏定量合并证据，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：性别差异影响许多慢性心血管代谢疾病的发生和临床表现。心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，常与代谢综合征（MetS）共存，然而MetS是否在男性和女性中赋予不同的AF风险仍不完全清楚。

内容：流行病学证据一致表明，MetS使新发AF的风险增加约1.4至1.9倍。在MetS组分中，血压升高和腹型肥胖与AF发作的关联最强。大多数研究还揭示，在所有年龄组中，男性的AF发生率高于女性，尽管女性绝经后AF发病率急剧上升。在MetS个体中，观察到类似的性别相关趋势：男性通常表现出更高且更早的AF发病率，而女性则在老年期经历延迟但陡峭的增加。生物学差异——特别是性激素驱动的脂肪分布、脂质代谢、胰岛素敏感性和炎症变化——可能是这些模式的基础。绝经前女性倾向于积累皮下、代谢良性脂肪，而男性优先储存内脏脂肪，促进更早的代谢功能障碍和AF易感性。绝经后，雌激素水平下降使女性转向中心性肥胖和心血管代谢恶化，缩小了AF发病率差距。自主神经平衡和肥胖相关交感激活的性别差异可能进一步调节AF风险。

结论：虽然MetS增加两性的AF风险，但越来越多的证据表明，这种风险的大小、时机和潜在机制在男性和女性之间不同。有必要更好地将性别特异性生物学通路整合到AF预防策略中。

title: Prompt versus deferred conditional cardioversion strategies after early AF recurrence following pulsed field ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The optimal timing of cardioversion for sustained atrial fibrillation (AF) recurrence after pulsed-field ablation (PFA) remains uncertain. We compared prompt and deferred conditional-cardioversion strategies in relation to subsequent AF burden.

METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 214 adults with continuously monitored AF lasting at least 24 h during the 8-week blanking period after first-time PFA. At eligibility, each patient was cloned to two dynamic strategies: attempting cardioversion within 48 h if AF persisted or withholding nonrescue cardioversion for 7 days. Strategy deviations were artificially censored and inverse-probability weighted. The primary per-protocol estimand was the strategy difference in cumulative AF days from postablation days 57 through 365.

RESULTS: Artificial censoring occurred in 35.5% and 59.3% of prompt- and deferred-strategy clones, respectively; the corresponding effective sample sizes were 124.7 and 72.9. Standardized mean cumulative AF exposure was 17.9 days under the prompt strategy and 30.5 days under the deferred strategy (mean difference, -12.6 days; 95% CI, -21.6 to -4.6; mean ratio, 0.59; 95% CI, 0.40-0.84). The risk of first sustained recurrence after day 56 was 30.7% vs. 44.1% (weighted hazard ratio, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.45-0.91). Repeat cardioversion and AF-related hospitalization were also less frequent under the prompt strategy. Continuation of the qualifying episode accounted for approximately 39% of the primary difference; after excluding this component, AF burden from distinct subsequent episodes remained lower under the prompt strategy (mean difference, -7.7 days; 95% CI, -14.9 to -1.1). Safety events were uncommon.

CONCLUSIONS: A strategy of attempting prompt cardioversion when AF persisted was associated with lower subsequent AF burden than temporary deferral. Randomized validation is required before defining an optimal cardioversion window or making firm management recommendations.

AI.tldr: 在PFA术后早期AF复发的患者中，48小时内尝试复律策略较延迟7天策略可显著降低后续AF负荷（平均减少12.6天），并降低持续复发风险。
AI.motivation: PFA术后空白期内持续性AF复发的最佳复律时机尚不明确，既往缺乏比较立即与延迟复律策略对后续AF负荷影响的研究。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入214例首次PFA术后8周空白期内持续至少24小时AF的成人。采用克隆-删失-逆概率加权法模拟两种动态策略：48小时内尝试复律 vs 延迟7天非救援性复律。主要终点为术后57至365天累积AF天数，采用符合方案效应估计。
AI.result: 立即策略组标准化平均累积AF暴露为17.9天，延迟策略组为30.5天（平均差-12.6天，95%CI -21.6至-4.6；平均比0.59，95%CI 0.40-0.84）。第56天后首次持续复发风险分别为30.7% vs 44.1%（加权HR 0.64，95%CI 0.45-0.91）。立即策略组重复复律和AF相关住院也更少。排除延续发作的影响后，后续不同发作的AF负荷仍较低（平均差-7.7天，95%CI -14.9至-1.1）。安全性事件少见。
AI.conclusion: PFA术后早期AF复发时，立即尝试复律策略与较低的后续AF负荷相关，但需随机对照试验验证后才能确定最佳复律窗口和临床推荐。

title: Standardized 4-step surgical approach to address atrial fibrillation during coronary artery bypass grafting in a patient with severely reduced left ventricular function: a case report.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) may result in haemodynamic deterioration and is particularly detrimental in patients with severely impaired left ventricular function. In this high-risk population, the maintenance or restoration of sinus rhythm (SR) in cardiac surgery are of paramount importance, warranting the use of all available surgical strategies to comprehensively address atrial fibrillation. We report the case of a 60-year-old man who underwent successful out-of-hospital cardiopulmonary resuscitation following an acute myocardial infarction. Coronary angiography revealed severe three-vessel coronary artery disease, accompanied by highly reduced left ventricular function. The patient had a history of symptomatic paroxysmal AF and had recently undergone electrical cardioversion to restore SR after the index myocardial infarction. In addition to surgical coronary revascularization via median sternotomy, a standardized four-step concomitant AF procedure was performed. This approach included bipolar radiofrequency ablation, exclusion of the left atrial appendage, transection of the ligament of Marshall, and left-sided posterior pericardiotomy. The patient was successfully weaned from cardiopulmonary bypass in SR and maintained stable SR throughout an 8-month follow-up period without AF recurrence. This case highlights the importance of systematically addressing AF during cardiac surgery, especially in high-risk patients with severely reduced ventricular function, where maintenance of sinus rhythm may have haemodynamic benefits.

AI.tldr: 一例60岁男性严重左室功能减低合并阵发性房颤患者，在冠脉搭桥术中行标准化四步房颤手术，术后维持窦性心律8个月无复发。
AI.motivation: 房颤可导致血流动力学恶化，对左室功能严重减低的患者尤为不利。此类高危人群在心脏手术中维持或恢复窦性心律至关重要，但既往缺乏标准化的同期房颤手术策略报道。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为60岁男性，急性心肌梗死后院外心肺复苏成功，冠脉造影示严重三支病变伴左室功能重度减低，有症状性阵发性房颤史，近期电复律恢复窦性心律。在正中开胸冠脉血运重建同期，行标准化四步房颤手术：双极射频消融、左心耳排除、Marshall韧带离断、左侧后心包切开。
AI.result: 患者顺利脱离体外循环，术中及术后维持窦性心律，8个月随访期间无房颤复发。摘要未报告具体左室功能数值、消融参数及统计检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，对左室功能严重减低的高危患者，心脏手术中系统化处理房颤可能有助于维持窦性心律并带来血流动力学获益。但为单例报告，缺乏对照和长期随访，结论需更大样本研究验证。

title: Development and evaluation of a transesophageal echocardiography-derived left atrial appendage structure-function coupling index across the atrial fibrillation disease continuum.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a progressive disorder associated with atrial remodeling and thromboembolic risk. We developed a transesophageal echocardiography (TEE)-derived left atrial appendage (LAA) structure-function coupling index (LAA-SFCI), defined as LAA volumetric load relative to longitudinal deformation, and assessed its distribution along the AF disease continuum and its potential for risk re-stratification of patients without documented AF.

METHODS: This single-center, prospective, cross-sectional study included 267 patients undergoing clinically indicated TEE, classified by the 2023 American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association/American College of Clinical Pharmacy/Heart Rhythm Society (ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS) framework as Stage 1 (n = 68), Stage 2 (n = 65), Stage 3a (n = 66), or Stage 3b (n = 68). Seven candidate LAA-SFCIs were calculated as the LAA volume index (LAA-VI) divided by a functional measure, and the principal index was selected by ordinal logistic regression using the Akaike information criterion. Discrimination was compared using the DeLong test and internally validated by bootstrapping, and patients without documented AF (Stages 1-2) were stratified by the exploratory cutoff.

RESULTS: LAA-VI/LAA-GLS (LAA global longitudinal strain) provided the best model fit and rose across AF stages from 0.33 ± 0.11 to 0.86 ± 0.36 (mL/m2)/% (P < 0.001). In ordinal regression with the log-transformed index, each 1-SD increase remained associated with higher AF stage after adjustment for age, sex, body mass index, left ventricular ejection fraction, and left atrial volume index (odds ratio 11.04, 95% confidence interval 7.17-16.98). For Stage 1-2 versus Stage 3a-3b, its area under the curve (0.904; optimism-corrected 0.900) was significantly higher than those of LAA-VI (0.661) and LAA-GLS (0.824) (both DeLong P < 0.001). Among 133 patients without documented AF, 18 (13.5%) exceeded the cutoff of 0.460 (mL/m2)/%; these patients did not differ from the others in left atrial volume index or age.

CONCLUSION: In this cross-sectional study, LAA-VI/LAA-GLS characterized LAA structure-function uncoupling along the AF disease continuum. In patients without documented AF undergoing clinically indicated TEE, it identified a subgroup with an AF-like LAA phenotype not captured by conventional atrial size measures. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require external validation and longitudinal follow-up to determine their prognostic value.

AI.tldr: 经食管超声衍生的左心耳结构-功能耦合指数LAA-VI/LAA-GLS随房颤分期进展而升高，在未记录房颤患者中可识别出常规心房大小指标未捕捉的类房颤左心耳表型。
AI.motivation: 房颤是进行性疾病，与心房重构和血栓栓塞风险相关。既往缺乏能同时反映左心耳结构和功能的综合指标，且对未记录房颤人群的风险再分层手段有限。本研究旨在开发基于经食管超声的左心耳结构-功能耦合指数，并评估其在房颤疾病连续体中的分布及对无房颤记录患者的风险再分层潜力。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性横断面研究，纳入267例临床需要行经食管超声的患者，按2023 ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS框架分为1期（n=68）、2期（n=65）、3a期（n=66）、3b期（n=68）。计算7个候选左心耳结构-功能耦合指数（左心耳容积指数除以功能指标），通过序数逻辑回归和Akaike信息准则选择主指数。采用DeLong检验比较判别能力，并通过bootstrap进行内部验证；对无房颤记录患者（1-2期）按探索性截断值进行分层。
AI.result: LAA-VI/LAA-GLS模型拟合最佳，随房颤分期从0.33±0.11升至0.86±0.36 (mL/m2)/%（P<0.001）。在调整年龄、性别、体重指数、左心室射血分数和左心房容积指数后，对数转换指数每增加1个标准差仍与更高房颤分期相关（OR 11.04，95%CI 7.17-16.98）。对于1-2期 vs 3a-3b期，其AUC为0.904（乐观校正后0.900），显著高于LAA-VI（0.661）和LAA-GLS（0.824）（DeLong P均<0.001）。在133例无房颤记录患者中，18例（13.5%）超过截断值0.460 (mL/m2)/%，这些患者在左心房容积指数或年龄上与其他患者无差异。
AI.conclusion: 本横断面研究显示，LAA-VI/LAA-GLS可刻画房颤疾病连续体中的左心耳结构-功能解耦联。在临床需要行经食管超声的无房颤记录患者中，该指数识别出一个具有类房颤左心耳表型的亚组，而常规心房大小指标未能捕捉。这些发现具有假设生成性，需要外部验证和纵向随访以确定其预后价值。

title: Benchmarking metabolic surrogate indices against body mass index for left atrial diameter in atrial fibrillation: a two-cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic surrogate indices are increasingly used in atrial fibrillation (AF), but several algebraically incorporate body mass index (BMI). We examined whether their associations with left atrial diameter (LAD) provide information beyond a simple anthropometric benchmark.

METHODS: We analyzed 788 patients in a primary AF cohort and 813 in a replication cohort. Seven prespecified metabolic surrogate indices were compared with BMI using harmonized linear models. We evaluated adjusted associations and incremental R² (ΔR²), partitioned shared and unique ΔR² by commonality analysis, and quantified BMI-index ΔR² differences by paired bootstrap resampling. Sensitivity analyses addressed body-size indexing, additional height/BSA covariate adjustment, AF-phenotype stratification, and covariate specification.

RESULTS: Indices without BMI in their formulas-TyG, TG/HDL-C, TG/G, and CHG-added little ΔR² in either cohort (all <0.4 percentage points). SPISE, TyG-BMI, and METS-IR contributed 5.66, 4.79, and 4.45 percentage points in the primary cohort and 3.57, 3.51, and 3.35 percentage points in the replication cohort, versus 6.23 and 4.29 percentage points for BMI. Most ΔR² of the BMI-containing indices was shared with BMI, whereas index-unique components were small. Bootstrap comparisons supported numerically similar or greater ΔR² for BMI, although confidence intervals did not uniformly exclude zero. Height-adjusted raw-LAD models preserved the comparative pattern, whereas additional BSA adjustment substantially attenuated BMI-related associations, supporting a body-size/allometric component.

CONCLUSIONS: Indices without BMI in their formulas added little ΔR² for contemporaneous LAD, whereas BMI-containing composites derived most of their ΔR² from variance shared with BMI. BMI provided numerically similar or greater ΔR², although paired bootstrap comparisons were not statistically distinguishable for all comparisons. Additional body-size covariate analyses indicated that a substantial component of these associations may reflect body-size/allometric structure. BMI should therefore be an explicit benchmark when evaluating metabolic surrogate indices for left atrial size.

AI.tldr: 在房颤患者中，不含BMI的代谢替代指标对左房内径的额外解释力很小，而含BMI的复合指标大部分解释力与BMI共享，BMI本身提供了相似或更大的解释力。
AI.motivation: 代谢替代指标在房颤中应用渐多，但部分指标公式包含BMI，其与左房内径的关联是否超越简单人体测量学基准（BMI）尚不明确。
AI.method: 两项队列研究（主队列788例，复制队列813例），比较7种预设代谢替代指标与BMI对左房内径的关联。采用统一线性模型评估调整后关联和增量R²（ΔR²），通过共同性分析分解共享与独特ΔR²，并用配对bootstrap重采样量化BMI与指标间ΔR²差异。敏感性分析包括体表面积索引、额外身高/BSA协变量调整、房颤表型分层和协变量设定。
AI.result: 不含BMI的指标（TyG、TG/HDL-C、TG/G、CHG）在两个队列中ΔR²均<0.4个百分点。含BMI的指标SPISE、TyG-BMI、METS-IR在主队列ΔR²分别为5.66、4.79、4.45个百分点，复制队列为3.57、3.51、3.35个百分点，而BMI为6.23和4.29个百分点。含BMI指标的大部分ΔR²与BMI共享，指标独特成分小。Bootstrap比较支持BMI的ΔR²数值相似或更大，但置信区间并非均排除零。身高调整的原始LAD模型保持比较模式，额外BSA调整显著减弱BMI相关关联。
AI.conclusion: 不含BMI的代谢替代指标对同期左房内径的增量解释力很小，含BMI复合指标的大部分解释力来自与BMI共享的方差。BMI提供了相似或更大的ΔR²，但配对bootstrap比较并非所有比较均达统计学差异。体表面积协变量分析提示这些关联的相当部分可能反映体型/异速生长结构。因此，评估代谢替代指标对左房大小的影响时，BMI应作为明确基准。

背景：代谢替代指标在房颤（AF）中的应用日益增多，但其中若干指标在代数上纳入了体重指数（BMI）。我们检验了这些指标与左心房内径（LAD）的关联是否提供了超越简单人体测量学基准的信息。

方法：我们分析了主要AF队列中的788例患者和重复队列中的813例患者。使用统一线性模型将七项预设的代谢替代指标与BMI进行比较。我们评估了校正后关联和增量R²（ΔR²），通过共同性分析划分共享和独特的ΔR²，并通过配对自举重采样量化BMI与指标间ΔR²差异。敏感性分析涉及体表面积索引、额外身高/BSA协变量校正、AF表型分层以及协变量设定。

结果：公式中不含BMI的指标——TyG、TG/HDL-C、TG/G和CHG——在两个队列中增加的ΔR²均很小（均<0.4个百分点）。SPISE、TyG-BMI和METS-IR在主要队列中分别贡献5.66、4.79和4.45个百分点，在重复队列中分别贡献3.57、3.51和3.35个百分点，而BMI分别为6.23和4.29个百分点。含BMI指标的大部分ΔR²与BMI共享，而指标独特成分较小。自举比较支持BMI的ΔR²在数值上相似或更大，尽管置信区间并非一致排除零。身高校正的原始LAD模型保留了比较模式，而额外BSA校正显著减弱了BMI相关关联，支持体表面积/异速生长成分。

结论：公式中不含BMI的指标对同期LAD增加的ΔR²很小，而含BMI的复合指标其ΔR²大部分来自与BMI共享的方差。BMI提供了数值上相似或更大的ΔR²，尽管配对自举比较并非所有比较均具有统计学差异。额外的体表面积协变量分析表明，这些关联的相当一部分可能反映体表面积/异速生长结构。因此，在评估左心房大小的代谢替代指标时，BMI应作为明确的基准。

title: Label-free comparative proteomic analysis reveals distinct profiles of direct oral anticoagulants in human endothelial cells.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) are the first-line treatment for thromboembolism prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation. Clinical and preclinical studies suggest that, beyond their anticoagulant properties, DOACs may have additional vascular effects. However, their effects on endothelial protein-abundance profiles remain incompletely characterized. The objective of this study was to explore the protein-abundance profiles associated with exposure of human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) to each of the four DOACs in the absence of external stimuli, using a label-free quantification (LFQ) methodology.

METHODS: Cultured HUVECs were exposed for 6 h to concentrations selected to approximate reported therapeutic plasma concentrations of apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban, and dabigatran. All experiments were carried out in serum-free media, after a starvation period of 18 h. After protein extraction using the TRIzol Reagent, label-free quantitative proteomic analysis was performed using nanoLC-MS/MS, followed by the identification of differentially abundant proteins (DAPs) and bioinformatic enrichment analyses.

RESULTS: We identified 1,643 protein entries, of which 753 were differentially abundant. Of these, 32 showed higher abundance and 26 showed lower abundance than the vehicle control in all four DOAC comparisons. Proteins showing shared abundance changes were mapped to gene identifiers that were enriched for annotations related to autophagy and cardiac development, and cellular activation. Several proteins showing abundance changes in all three FXa-inhibitor comparisons, but not in the dabigatran comparison, were mapped to annotations related to hypoxia response, vascular permeability, and cholesterol homeostasis. However, this comparison is potentially confounded by the absence of an HCl-matched vehicle control for dabigatran. The majority of DAPs were drug specific, with distinct signatures for each DOAC. Exploratory enrichment subnetworks linked mapped gene identifiers from drug specific protein sets to ontology terms including endothelial-cell chemotaxis, sodium-ion transport, necrotic cell death, mRNA splicing, and regulation of gene expression. These cellular functions were not directly measured.

CONCLUSION: Under the experimental conditions used, exposure to the four DOACs was associated with common and drug-specific protein-abundance patterns in HUVECs. These protein-abundance patterns provide hypothesis-generating observations for subsequent functional investigation.

AI.result: 共鉴定1,643个蛋白条目，其中753个为差异丰度蛋白。在四种DOAC比较中，32个蛋白丰度高于载体对照，26个低于对照。共享变化蛋白富集于自噬、心脏发育和细胞激活相关注释。三种FXa抑制剂比较中共享但达比加群比较中未见的蛋白变化映射至缺氧反应、血管通透性和胆固醇稳态相关注释，但该比较可能因达比加群缺乏HCl匹配的载体对照而混杂。多数DAPs为药物特异性，每种DOAC具有独特特征。探索性富集亚网络将药物特异性蛋白集映射至内皮细胞趋化、钠离子转运、坏死性细胞死亡、mRNA剪接和基因表达调控等本体术语，但这些细胞功能未直接测量。

引言：直接口服抗凝药（DOACs）是心房颤动患者预防血栓栓塞的一线治疗。临床和临床前研究表明，除抗凝特性外，DOACs可能具有额外的血管效应。然而，它们对内皮细胞蛋白质丰度谱的影响仍未完全明确。本研究旨在采用非标记定量（LFQ）方法，探讨在无外部刺激条件下，人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）暴露于四种DOACs中每一种时相关的蛋白质丰度谱。

title: Response to Comment on: "Carbon footprint of direct oral anticoagulants in atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolism".
Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation: Navigating Heterogeneity in Clinical Evidence: JACC Evidence Review.
summary: Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) has emerged as an alternative to long-term anticoagulation for preventing stroke or systemic embolism in selected patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) based on several randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that collectively enrolled >7,000 participants. In this JACC Evidence Review, we interpret the major RCTs as distinct experiments, clarify what each can and cannot establish, and offer a phenotype-based framework for interpreting the evidence. The most recent RCTs, OPTION, CLOSURE-AF, and CHAMPION-AF, have prompted efforts to pool the evidence into a single summary estimate. However, these trials are not one coherent evidence base; they are distinct clinical experiments that asked different questions. They differ in patient phenotype, comparator, device generation, postprocedure antithrombotic regimen, endpoint construction, and follow-up duration. Study-level meta-analysis of published reports remains methodologically valid for estimating the broad direction of effect of a device class, but when the component trials differ materially in patient phenotype, comparator, and outcome construction, the pooled estimate does not map to a common patient group or treatment decision. Patient eligibility as well as thromboembolic and bleeding risk varied markedly across trials. In addition, device technology has progressed, and comparators have evolved from warfarin to direct oral anticoagulants. Heterogeneity and insufficient details also exist about the antithrombotic therapy regimen in LAAC arms and adjunct antiplatelet therapy in control arms. Methodological issues further complicate interpretation, including the use of bleeding events (ie, the putative ancillary benefit of LAAC compared with anticoagulation) within composite endpoints tested for noninferiority, varying noninferiority margins, analytical approaches that may undermine the interpretation of noninferiority, and exclusion of periprocedural bleeding from primary safety endpoints in some trials. Finally, the standard of care for anticoagulation in AF has evolved, obviating concomitant aspirin use in stable individuals on therapeutic anticoagulation, thereby reducing bleeding risk compared with that of the control arm of LAAC RCTs. For most anticoagulation-eligible patients, anticoagulation remains the preferred first-line strategy. LAAC is a reasonable option when long-term anticoagulation is unsafe or unsustainable provided that procedural risk, adjunct antithrombotic feasibility, surveillance needs, and competing mortality are carefully considered. RCT evidence in this latter population is limited, and RCTs in other populations have features that limit their support for LAAC as an alternative to anticoagulation. Because LAAC and anticoagulation offer different types of risk, aligning the most applicable evidence with patient values through shared decision-making is central to care.

AI.tldr: 本综述指出，LAAC 与抗凝治疗的 RCT 在人群表型、对照、器械代际和终点构建上差异显著，不宜简单合并；对抗凝可耐受的 AF 患者，抗凝仍是首选一线策略。
AI.motivation: LAAC 已被多项 RCT（合计>7000例）评估为 AF 患者长期抗凝的替代方案，近期 OPTION、CLOSURE-AF、CHAMPION-AF 等试验促使人们将证据合并为单一汇总估计；但各试验提出的临床问题不同，合并估计可能无法对应到共同的患者群体或治疗决策，需要厘清各试验能证明与不能证明什么。
AI.method: JACC Evidence Review（叙述性证据综述），无新入组患者。将主要 LAAC 相关 RCT 视为彼此独立的临床试验逐一解读，比较其在患者表型、对照治疗（华法林 vs DOAC）、器械代际、术后抗栓方案、终点构建及随访时长上的差异；讨论研究水平 meta 分析在异质性显著时的适用边界，并分析非劣效性设计中的方法学问题（出血事件纳入复合终点、非劣效界值不一、围术期出血被排除于主要安全性终点等）。摘要未报告系统检索策略与定量合并结果。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量与 95%CI、P 值。定性指出：各试验入选标准及血栓栓塞与出血风险差异明显；对照由华法林演进为 DOAC；LAAC 组抗栓方案与对照组附加抗血小板治疗细节不足；部分试验将出血事件（LAAC 的假定附加获益）纳入用于非劣效检验的复合终点，非劣效界值不一致，部分分析方式可能影响非劣效性解读，部分试验主要安全性终点排除围术期出血；当前抗凝标准治疗已不再要求稳定抗凝者联用阿司匹林，使 LAAC 试验对照组出血风险高于现行实践。
AI.conclusion: 对大多数适合抗凝的 AF 患者，抗凝仍是首选一线策略；仅当长期抗凝不安全或不可持续时，LAAC 才是合理选择，且需综合评估手术风险、辅助抗栓可行性、监测需求与竞争性死亡风险。该人群的 RCT 证据有限，其他人群的 RCT 因上述特征限制了对 LAAC 替代抗凝的支持；LAAC 与抗凝的风险类型不同，应通过共享决策将最适用的证据与患者价值观对齐。局限性：本文为证据评述而非系统评价，未提供定量合并结果。

summary_zh: 左心耳封堵（LAAC）已成为部分房颤（AF）患者预防卒中或系统性栓塞的长期抗凝替代方案，其依据是多项随机对照试验（RCT），这些试验共纳入超过7,000名受试者。在本JACC证据综述中，我们将主要RCT视为不同的实验进行解读，阐明每项试验能够和不能够确立的内容，并提供一个基于表型的框架来解读证据。最近的RCT——OPTION、CLOSURE-AF和CHAMPION-AF——促使人们努力将证据汇总为单一的汇总估计。然而，这些试验并非一个连贯的证据基础；它们是提出了不同问题的不同临床实验。它们在患者表型、对照、器械世代、术后抗血栓方案、终点构建和随访持续时间方面存在差异。对已发表报告进行的研究水平荟萃分析在方法学上仍然有效，可用于估计某一器械类别的总体效应方向，但当组成试验在患者表型、对照和结局构建方面存在实质性差异时，汇总估计并不映射到共同的患者群体或治疗决策。各试验间患者入选资格以及血栓栓塞和出血风险差异显著。此外，器械技术已经进步，对照已从华法林演变为直接口服抗凝药。关于LAAC组的抗血栓治疗方案和对照组的辅助抗血小板治疗，也存在异质性和细节不足。方法学问题进一步使解读复杂化，包括在用于非劣效性检验的复合终点中使用出血事件（即LAAC与抗凝相比的假定辅助获益）、不同的非劣效性界值、可能削弱非劣效性解读的分析方法，以及某些试验将围手术期出血排除在主要安全性终点之外。最后，房颤抗凝的标准治疗已经演变，使得在接受治疗性抗凝的稳定个体中无需联用阿司匹林，从而与LAAC RCT的对照组相比降低了出血风险。对于大多数适合抗凝的患者，抗凝仍是首选的一线策略。当长期抗凝不安全或不可持续时，LAAC是一个合理的选择，前提是仔细考虑手术风险、辅助抗血栓治疗的可行性、监测需求和竞争性死亡风险。后一人群的RCT证据有限，而其他人群的RCT具有限制其支持LAAC作为抗凝替代方案的特征。由于LAAC和抗凝提供不同类型的风险，通过共享决策将最适用的证据与患者价值观对齐是医疗的核心。

title: When and How to Consider Left Atrial Appendage Closure as a Management Option for Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A European Perspective.
Left Atrial Appendage Closure in Atrial Fibrillation Patients With High Risk of Stroke and Bleeding: An Individual Participant Data Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) is increasingly used as an alternative to oral anticoagulation for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation. Its comparative effectiveness and safety in patients at a high risk of both stroke and bleeding remain uncertain.

OBJECTIVES: We evaluated the efficacy and safety of LAAC vs contemporary medical therapy in a high-risk population using individual participant data from randomized trials.

METHODS: Bibliographic databases and trial registries through August 5, 2026, were searched for randomized trials comparing percutaneous LAAC with contemporary medical therapy in populations with a trial-level mean CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥4. A 1-stage common-effect analysis used Cox models stratified by trial and adjusted for age, sex, CHA2DS2-VASc score, and HAS-BLED score. Both primary outcomes were time to first stroke, systemic embolism, or cardiovascular/unknown death (efficacy) and time to first major bleeding (safety). A flexible time-varying Cox model was used for major bleeding. The protocol was submitted to PROSPERO (CRD420261335972).

RESULTS: CLOSURE-AF (Left Atrial Appendage CLOSURE in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation Compared to Medical Therapy) and PRAGUE-17 (Left Atrial Appendage Closure vs. Novel Anticoagulation Agents in Atrial Fibrillation) contributed 1,290 participants (647 assigned to LAAC and 643 to control). Median age was 77.3 years (Q1-Q3: 71.4-81.9 years), and 809 participants (62.7%) were men. The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 142 LAAC participants (21.9%) and 133 control subjects (20.7%) (adjusted HR: 0.98; 95% CI: 0.77-1.24; P = 0.842). Major bleeding occurred in 86 LAAC participants (13.3%) and 80 control subjects (12.4%) (adjusted HR: 1.03; 95% CI: 0.75-1.39; P = 0.874). The treatment effect on major bleeding varied over time (P for treatment-by-time interaction < 0.001), with a cumulative major bleeding incidence of 9.4% with LAAC vs 6.0% with control (absolute risk difference, 3.4 percentage points; 95% CI: 0.4-6.3 percentage points) at 1 year and 13.2% vs 12.1% (absolute risk difference, 1.1 percentage points; 95% CI: -2.8 to 5.0 percentage points) at 3 years.

CONCLUSIONS: In high-risk patients with atrial fibrillation, no statistically significant difference was detected between LAAC and contemporary medical therapy for the primary efficacy outcome or major bleeding. The major bleeding hazard varied over time, with higher early and lower later conditional hazard estimates; however, a cumulative bleeding benefit was not demonstrated by 3 years. Long-term randomized data are needed to improve the precision of later treatment-effect estimates.

AI.tldr: 在卒中与出血双高危房颤患者中，左心耳封堵与现行药物治疗在主要疗效终点及大出血上均无显著差异，大出血风险随时间变化，1年时LAAC组累积发生率更高，3年时未显示出血获益。
