AI.method: 研究为随机试验的个体参与者数据荟萃分析，检索至2026年8月5日，纳入试验层面平均CHA2DS2-VASc≥4的随机试验；采用1阶段共同效应分析，Cox模型按试验分层并校正年龄、性别、CHA2DS2-VASc和HAS-BLED评分；主要疗效终点为首次卒中、系统性栓塞或心血管/不明原因死亡，主要安全终点为首次大出血，大出血采用灵活时变Cox模型；方案注册于PROSPERO（CRD420261335972）。
AI.result: CLOSURE-AF与PRAGUE-17共纳入1,290例（LAAC组647例、对照组643例），中位年龄77.3岁，男性809例（62.7%）。主要疗效终点LAAC组142例（21.9%）vs 对照组133例（20.7%），校正HR 0.98（95%CI 0.77-1.24，P=0.842）；大出血86例（13.3%）vs 80例（12.4%），校正HR 1.03（95%CI 0.75-1.39，P=0.874）。大出血的治疗效应随时间变化（治疗×时间交互P<0.001）：1年累积发生率LAAC 9.4% vs 对照6.0%（绝对风险差3.4个百分点，95%CI 0.4-6.3），3年为13.2% vs 12.1%（绝对风险差1.1个百分点，95%CI -2.8至5.0）。
AI.conclusion: 在卒中与出血双高危房颤患者中，LAAC与现行药物治疗在主要疗效终点及大出血上均未检出统计学显著差异；大出血风险随时间变化，早期风险较高、后期条件风险较低，但3年内未证实累积出血获益。该结果提示对此类高危人群选择LAAC替代抗凝需个体化权衡，尤其关注术后早期出血风险；需更长期随机数据以提高后期治疗效应估计的精度。

summary_zh:
背景：经皮左心耳封堵（LAAC）越来越多地被用作口服抗凝药的替代方案，用于心房颤动患者的卒中预防。在卒中和出血风险均高的患者中，其比较有效性和安全性仍不确定。

目的：我们使用随机试验的个体参与者数据，评估LAAC与当代药物治疗在高风险人群中的有效性和安全性。

方法：检索截至2026年8月5日的文献数据库和试验注册库，寻找在试验水平平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分≥4的人群中比较经皮LAAC与当代药物治疗的随机试验。采用一阶段共同效应分析，使用按试验分层并校正年龄、性别、CHA2DS2-VASc评分和HAS-BLED评分的Cox模型。两个主要结局分别为至首次卒中、系统性栓塞或心血管/不明原因死亡的时间（有效性）和至首次大出血的时间（安全性）。对大出血使用灵活的时间变化Cox模型。方案已提交至PROSPERO（CRD420261335972）。

结果：CLOSURE-AF（左心耳封堵在心房颤动患者中与药物治疗的比较）和PRAGUE-17（左心耳封堵与新型抗凝药在心房颤动中的比较）贡献了1,290名参与者（647名分配至LAAC，643名分配至对照）。中位年龄为77.3岁（Q1-Q3：71.4-81.9岁），809名参与者（62.7%）为男性。主要有效性结局发生在142名LAAC参与者（21.9%）和133名对照受试者（20.7%）中（校正HR：0.98；95% CI：0.77-1.24；P = 0.842）。大出血发生在86名LAAC参与者（13.3%）和80名对照受试者（12.4%）中（校正HR：1.03；95% CI：0.75-1.39；P = 0.874）。对大出血的治疗效应随时间变化（治疗-时间交互作用P < 0.001），1年时LAAC的累积大出血发生率为9.4% vs 对照的6.0%（绝对风险差异，3.4个百分点；95% CI：0.4-6.3个百分点），3年时为13.2% vs 12.1%（绝对风险差异，1.1个百分点；95% CI：-2.8至5.0个百分点）。

结论：在心房颤动高风险患者中，LAAC与当代药物治疗在主要有效性结局或大出血方面未检测到统计学显著差异。大出血风险随时间变化，早期条件风险估计较高而后期较低；然而，至3年时未证明累积出血获益。需要长期随机数据以提高后期治疗效应估计的精确度。

title: Comparison of Outcomes Between Men and Women Treated With Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Oral Anticoagulation After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: An OPTION Subanalysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Women sex is an established, nonmodifiable risk factor for adverse outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) has been proposed as an alternative to oral anticoagulation (OAC) for stroke prevention in patients with AF; however, there are limited data on sex-based outcomes of LAAC following catheter ablation.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to compare outcomes of LAAC vs OAC after AF ablation in men and women.

METHODS: Patients with AF and CHA2DS2-VASc ≥2 in men and ≥3 in women were randomized 1:1 to either ablation + LAAC or ablation + OAC. The primary safety endpoint was nonprocedural major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding at 36 months. The primary efficacy endpoint was a composite of all-cause death, stroke, or systemic embolism at 36 months.

RESULTS: The study included 1,053 men and 546 women. LAAC and OAC demonstrated comparable primary efficacy events in men (HR: 0.96; 95% CI: 0.56-1.65; P = 0.88) and women (HR: 0.81; 95% CI: 0.41-1.62; P = 0.55), with no treatment-by-sex interaction (P interaction = 0.71). Procedural complication rates were similar at 2.3% in men and 3.7% in women with only 1 pericardial effusion in each group, not related to the index LAAC procedure. At 36 months, the primary safety endpoint was significantly lower in the device group among men (HR: 0.34; 95% CI: 0.23-0.50; P < 0.0001). In women, a similar but nonsignificant trend was observed (HR: 0.68; 95% CI: 0.42-1.09; P = 0.11), with a significant treatment-by-sex interaction (P interaction = 0.02). No significant difference was seen in the secondary safety endpoint across both treatment arms for either sex.

CONCLUSIONS: In this prespecified analysis of the OPTION (Comparison of Anticoagulation With Left Atrial Appendage Closure After AF Ablation [OPTION]) trial, stroke, systemic embolism, and mortality outcomes were not significantly different between LAAC and OAC following AF ablation in either men or women. Compared with OAC, LAAC demonstrated a greater magnitude of major and clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding reduction in men as compared with women. (Comparison of Anticoagulation With Left Atrial Appendage Closure After AF Ablation [OPTION]; NCT03795298).

AI.tldr: 房颤消融后，LAAC与OAC在男性和女性中的卒中/死亡复合终点无显著差异，但LAAC减少出血的幅度在男性中显著大于女性。
AI.motivation: 女性是房颤不良结局的既定危险因素，LAAC作为OAC替代方案在消融后人群中的性别差异数据有限，本研究旨在比较男性和女性中LAAC与OAC的结局。
AI.method: OPTION试验预设亚组分析，纳入CHA2DS2-VASc≥2的男性和≥3的女性房颤患者，1:1随机至消融+LAAC或消融+OAC，主要安全终点为36个月非手术相关大出血或临床相关非大出血，主要疗效终点为36个月全因死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞复合终点。
AI.result: 共纳入1053例男性和546例女性。主要疗效终点在男性（HR 0.96，95%CI 0.56-1.65，P=0.88）和女性（HR 0.81，95%CI 0.41-1.62，P=0.55）中LAAC与OAC均无显著差异，无性别交互作用（P interaction=0.71）。手术并发症率男性2.3%、女性3.7%，每组仅1例心包积液且与LAAC手术无关。36个月主要安全终点在男性中LAAC显著低于OAC（HR 0.34，95%CI 0.23-0.50，P<0.0001），女性中呈相似但不显著趋势（HR 0.68，95%CI 0.42-1.09，P=0.11），存在显著性别交互作用（P interaction=0.02）。次要安全终点在两性中均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 房颤消融后，LAAC与OAC在男性和女性中的卒中、系统性栓塞和死亡结局无显著差异；LAAC减少大出血和临床相关非大出血的幅度在男性中大于女性。临床实践中应考虑性别差异制定个体化抗栓策略，但女性样本量较小且为亚组分析，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：女性是心房颤动（AF）患者不良结局的既定且不可改变的危险因素。左心耳封堵（LAAC）已被提出作为口服抗凝（OAC）的替代方案，用于AF患者的卒中预防；然而，关于导管消融后LAAC的性别结局数据有限。

目的：本研究旨在比较男性和女性AF消融后LAAC与OAC的结局。

方法：男性CHA2DS2-VASc≥2且女性≥3的AF患者按1:1随机分配至消融+LAAC或消融+OAC。主要安全性终点为36个月时非手术相关的大出血或临床相关非大出血。主要有效性终点为36个月时全因死亡、卒中或系统性栓塞的复合终点。

结果：研究纳入1,053名男性和546名女性。LAAC和OAC在男性（HR：0.96；95% CI：0.56-1.65；P = 0.88）和女性（HR：0.81；95% CI：0.41-1.62；P = 0.55）的主要有效性事件方面相当，无治疗-by-性别交互作用（P interaction = 0.71）。手术并发症率相似，男性为2.3%，女性为3.7%，每组仅1例心包积液，与索引LAAC手术无关。在36个月时，男性中器械组的主要安全性终点显著较低（HR：0.34；95% CI：0.23-0.50；P < 0.0001）。在女性中，观察到相似但不显著的趋势（HR：0.68；95% CI：0.42-1.09；P = 0.11），具有显著的治疗-by-性别交互作用（P interaction = 0.02）。在两种性别中，两个治疗组之间的次要安全性终点均未见显著差异。

结论：在这项OPTION（AF消融后抗凝与左心耳封堵比较[OPTION]）试验的预设分析中，AF消融后LAAC与OAC在男性和女性中的卒中、系统性栓塞和死亡率结局均无显著差异。与OAC相比，LAAC在男性中显示出的主要和临床相关非大出血减少幅度大于女性。（AF消融后抗凝与左心耳封堵比较[OPTION]；NCT03795298）。

title: Antithrombotic Therapy Management After Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Current Regimens, Evolving Evidence, and the Control Group Dilemma.
summary: Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure is increasingly used for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation, particularly when long-term oral anticoagulation (OAC) is unsuitable. Although postprocedural antithrombotic therapy is necessary to prevent device-related thrombosis (DRT), it may increase bleeding and attenuate the benefit of avoiding long-term OAC. Uncertainty over the optimal antithrombotic strategy persists, with available randomized trials being small and heterogeneous. Direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) monotherapy and dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) are 2 common early strategies. In ANDES, DRT was numerically less frequent with DOAC than with DAPT (1.5% vs 4.1%). In ADALA, low-dose apixaban was associated with greater net benefit than DAPT (HR: 0.19; P = 0.02), although enrollment was prematurely stopped. A meta-analysis of randomized trials found significantly lower DRT with DOAC than with DAPT (risk ratio: 0.17). Current guidelines endorse regimens largely based on device-specific trial protocols or low-certainty evidence. During the initial postimplantation period, antithrombotic therapy should primarily aim to support device healing and prevent DRT, with treatment intensity tailored according to risk profile, concomitant indications, patient preferences, and the feasibility of imaging follow-up. Reassessment at 45 to 90 days should guide de-escalation once adequate device healing has been confirmed, with no fixed treatment stop date. In the absence of device-related complications, long-term OAC or DAPT should be continued only for concomitant indications, whereas continuation of single antiplatelet therapy or complete withdrawal of antithrombotic therapy should be individualized according to thrombotic and bleeding risk. Finally, definite or probable DRT generally warrants OAC, when feasible; in contrast, treatment decisions should not be based solely on the presence or size of a peridevice leak. This review critically appraises the available evidence and guideline recommendations and discusses how treatment intensity and duration may be tailored over time according to evolving thrombotic and bleeding risks.

AI.tldr: 左心耳封堵术后抗栓策略中，DOAC单药较DAPT显著降低装置相关血栓风险，但现有证据质量低，需个体化治疗。
AI.motivation: 经皮左心耳封堵术用于不适合长期口服抗凝的房颤患者卒中预防，术后需抗栓治疗以预防装置相关血栓，但增加出血风险，最佳策略不确定，随机试验规模小且异质。
AI.method: 综述现有随机试验和指南，评估DOAC单药与DAPT等策略，主要终点为装置相关血栓和出血，采用描述性总结和荟萃分析。
AI.result: ANDES试验中DOAC组DRT发生率1.5% vs DAPT组4.1%；ADALA试验低剂量阿哌沙班净获益优于DAPT（HR 0.19; P=0.02），但提前终止；荟萃分析显示DOAC较DAPT显著降低DRT（风险比0.17）。
AI.conclusion: 术后早期抗栓以促进装置愈合和预防DRT为目标，45-90天评估后降阶，长期治疗仅用于合并指征，个体化决策；证据质量低，需更多随机试验。

summary_zh: 经皮左心耳封堵越来越多地用于心房颤动患者的卒中预防，尤其是当长期口服抗凝（OAC）不适合时。尽管术后抗栓治疗对于预防器械相关血栓（DRT）是必要的，但它可能增加出血并削弱避免长期OAC的获益。关于最佳抗栓策略的不确定性持续存在，现有随机试验规模小且异质性大。直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）单药治疗和双联抗血小板治疗（DAPT）是两种常见的早期策略。在ANDES试验中，DOAC相比DAPT的DRT发生率在数值上更低（1.5% vs 4.1%）。在ADALA试验中，低剂量阿哌沙班相比DAPT与更大的净获益相关（HR：0.19；P = 0.02），尽管入组被提前终止。一项随机试验的荟萃分析发现，DOAC相比DAPT显著降低DRT（风险比：0.17）。当前指南推荐的方案主要基于器械特异性试验方案或低确定性证据。在植入后初期，抗栓治疗应主要旨在支持器械愈合和预防DRT，治疗强度应根据风险特征、合并指征、患者偏好和影像学随访的可行性进行个体化调整。在45至90天时重新评估应指导降阶治疗，一旦确认器械充分愈合，且无固定治疗停止日期。在无器械相关并发症的情况下，长期OAC或DAPT应仅因合并指征而继续，而继续单一抗血小板治疗或完全停止抗栓治疗应根据血栓和出血风险个体化决定。最后，明确或可能的DRT在可行时通常需要OAC；相反，治疗决策不应仅基于器械周围漏的存在或大小。本综述批判性地评估了现有证据和指南推荐，并讨论了如何根据不断变化的血栓和出血风险随时间调整治疗强度和持续时间。

title: What Counts in a Stroke-Prevention Strategy?: A Patient-Centered Framework for Cardiovascular Care in Atrial Fibrillation.
To Close or Not to Close, That Is the Question: A Neurological Perspective on Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion in High-Risk Atrial Fibrillation Patients.
Safer Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: Factor XI/XIa Inhibitors, Left Atrial Appendage Closure, or Both?
LAAC for Atrial Fibrillation: Overhyped Device or Reasonable Alternative to Oral Anticoagulants?
Catheter Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation With Prior Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack: Insights From the CABANA Trial.
Computed Tomography-Derived Left Atrial Intramyocardial Fat and Low-Voltage Zones in Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Left atrial low-voltage zones (LVZs) are associated with atrial fibrosis and arrhythmia recurrence after atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation and are thought to underlie many recurrences despite durable pulmonary vein isolation. However, noninvasive markers of the arrhythmogenic atrial substrate remain poorly characterized. We sought to investigate the association between computed tomography (CT)-derived left atrial intramyocardial fat (inFAT) and electroanatomically defined LVZs.

METHODS AND RESULTS: In this single-center retrospective study, 145 consecutive patients undergoing first-time radiofrequency AF ablation underwent preprocedural dual-source CT and high-density left atrial voltage mapping in sinus rhythm. LVZs were defined as contiguous regions with bipolar voltage < 0.5 mV. ADAS 3D post-processing was used to quantify total inFAT, dense inFAT, and fat-myocardial admixture. LVZs were identified in 51 patients (35.2%). Compared with patients without LVZs, those with LVZs had a higher prevalence of persistent AF (58.8% vs. 17.0%; p < 0.001) and a greater left atrial volume index (LAVi) (74.41 [64.87-99.50] vs. 62.99 [52.78-74.73] mL/m2; p < 0.001). Patients with LVZs also demonstrated larger volumes of total inFAT, dense inFAT, and fat-myocardial admixture, accompanied by lower radiodensity values of total and dense inFAT. In multivariable logistic regression analysis, persistent AF (adjusted odds ratio [OR]: 5.389; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 2.162-13.433; p < 0.001) and dense inFAT volume (adjusted OR: 3.439; 95% CI: 1.107-10.677; p = 0.033) remained independently associated with the presence of LVZs, whereas LAVi did not. Among the CT-derived fat metrics, only dense inFAT retained an independent association with LVZs after adjustment for clinical covariates.

CONCLUSION: CT-derived dense inFAT was independently associated with left atrial LVZs and may represent a novel noninvasive marker of the arrhythmogenic atrial substrate in AF. Prospective studies are warranted to determine its role in substrate-guided ablation strategies and risk stratification.

AI.tldr: CT衍生的致密左房心肌内脂肪与房颤患者左房低电压区独立相关，或成为无创评估致心律失常基质的标志物。
AI.motivation: 左房低电压区（LVZ）与心房纤维化及房颤消融术后复发相关，但缺乏无创标志物。本研究探讨CT衍生的左房心肌内脂肪（inFAT）与电解剖标测定义的LVZ的关联。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入145例首次接受射频消融的房颤患者，术前接受双源CT和窦性心律下高密度左房电压标测。LVZ定义为双极电压<0.5 mV的连续区域。使用ADAS 3D后处理量化总inFAT、致密inFAT和脂肪-心肌混合。采用多变量logistic回归分析LVZ的独立相关因素。
AI.result: 51例（35.2%）存在LVZ。LVZ组持续性房颤比例更高（58.8% vs. 17.0%，p<0.001），左房容积指数更大（74.41 vs. 62.99 mL/m2，p<0.001）。LVZ组总inFAT、致密inFAT和混合体积更大，总inFAT和致密inFAT的放射密度更低。多变量分析中，持续性房颤（OR 5.389，95%CI 2.162-13.433，p<0.001）和致密inFAT体积（OR 3.439，95%CI 1.107-10.677，p=0.033）与LVZ独立相关，而左房容积指数无独立关联。
AI.conclusion: CT衍生的致密inFAT与左房LVZ独立相关，可能作为房颤致心律失常基质的无创标志物。需前瞻性研究确定其在基质指导消融策略和风险分层中的作用。

summary_zh:
引言：左心房低电压区（LVZs）与心房纤维化及心房颤动（AF）消融后心律失常复发相关，并被认为是在持久肺静脉隔离后许多复发的潜在基础。然而，致心律失常性心房基质的无创标志物仍特征不明。我们试图研究计算机断层扫描（CT）衍生的左心房心肌内脂肪（inFAT）与电解剖定义的LVZs之间的关联。

方法与结果：在这项单中心回顾性研究中，145例连续接受首次射频AF消融的患者在术前接受了双源CT和窦性心律下的高密度左心房电压标测。LVZs定义为双极电压< 0.5 mV的连续区域。使用ADAS 3D后处理量化总inFAT、致密inFAT和脂肪-心肌混合。51例患者（35.2%）中识别出LVZs。与无LVZs的患者相比，有LVZs的患者持续性AF的患病率更高（58.8% vs. 17.0%；p < 0.001），左心房容积指数（LAVi）更大（74.41 [64.87-99.50] vs. 62.99 [52.78-74.73] mL/m2；p < 0.001）。有LVZs的患者还显示总inFAT、致密inFAT和脂肪-心肌混合的体积更大，同时总inFAT和致密inFAT的放射密度值更低。在多变量逻辑回归分析中，持续性AF（调整比值比[OR]：5.389；95%置信区间[CI]：2.162-13.433；p < 0.001）和致密inFAT体积（调整OR：3.439；95% CI：1.107-10.677；p = 0.033）仍与LVZs的存在独立相关，而LAVi则不然。在CT衍生的脂肪指标中，只有致密inFAT在调整临床协变量后保留了与LVZs的独立关联。

结论：CT衍生的致密inFAT与左心房LVZs独立相关，可能代表AF中致心律失常性心房基质的一种新型无创标志物。需要前瞻性研究来确定其在基质指导的消融策略和风险分层中的作用。

title: Atrial Fibrillation Ablation in a Patient with Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Vein.
summary:
A 68-year-old man with persistent atrial fibrillation presented for ablation. Computed tomography showed a partial anomalous pulmonary venous return with connection of the right upper/middle vein to the superior vena cava. Wide antral circumferential ablation with pulse field ablation was used to isolate the normal veins connecting to the left atrium. The left atrium posterior right wall (usual position of the right upper pulmonary vein) and also the anomalous vein connection in the superior vena cava were important targets for mapping and possible ablation. However, in this case, these areas did not show independent firing and did not require additional ablation.

CLINICAL IMPACT: This is the first reported case of the use of pulse field ablation (PFA) in a patient with partial anomalous pulmonary venous return. This case highlights the use of dense mapping in a congenital anomaly to avoid the risk of inadvertent injury to surrounding structures (in this case, injury to the superior vena cava). We hope to show this unique application of PFA ablation in a patient with a congenitally anomalous pulmonary vein and encourage operators to benefit from using newer technologies like PFA in patients with other congenital anomalies.

AI.tldr: 首例报道脉冲场消融用于部分性肺静脉异位引流合并房颤患者，成功隔离正常肺静脉，异常静脉及左房后右壁无需额外消融。
AI.motivation: 部分性肺静脉异位引流（PAPVR）是先天性肺静脉异常，合并房颤时消融策略及安全性数据缺乏，脉冲场消融（PFA）在此类先天异常中的应用尚未见报道。
AI.method: 病例报告。68岁男性持续性房颤患者，CT示右上/中叶肺静脉异位连接至上腔静脉。采用PFA行宽环周消融隔离连接左房的正常肺静脉，并对左房后右壁（通常右上肺静脉位置）及上腔静脉内异常静脉连接处进行密集标测，评估是否需要额外消融。
AI.result: 正常肺静脉成功隔离；左房后右壁及上腔静脉内异常静脉连接处均未显示独立放电，未行额外消融。摘要未报告手术时间、透视时间、并发症等具体数据。
AI.conclusion: 首例PFA用于PAPVR合并房颤患者，提示PFA可用于先天异常患者，密集标测有助于避免误伤周围结构（如上腔静脉）。但为单例报告，结论需更多病例验证。

summary_zh:
一名68岁男性持续性心房颤动患者前来接受消融治疗。计算机断层扫描显示部分性肺静脉异位引流，右上/中叶静脉连接至上腔静脉。采用脉冲场消融进行宽环状消融，以隔离连接至左心房的正常静脉。左心房后右壁（右上肺静脉的通常位置）以及上腔静脉中的异常静脉连接是标测和可能消融的重要靶点。然而，在本病例中，这些区域未显示独立放电，无需额外消融。

临床影响：这是首例报道在部分性肺静脉异位引流患者中使用脉冲场消融（PFA）的病例。本病例强调了在先天性异常中使用密集标测以避免意外损伤周围结构（本例中为上腔静脉损伤）风险的重要性。我们希望展示PFA消融在先天性异常肺静脉患者中的这一独特应用，并鼓励术者在其他先天性异常患者中受益于使用PFA等新技术。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion and Percutaneous Coumadin Ridge Mass Exclusion: Two Targets, One Device.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mobile cardiac masses on the coumadin ridge are rare and carry significant embolic risk, compounded by concurrent atrial fibrillation. Surgical excision may be prohibitive in patients with high bleeding risk.

CASE SUMMARY: A 70-year-old man with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, a HAS-BLED score of 4, and aversion to anticoagulation was referred for left atrial appendage (LAA) closure. Imaging revealed an incidental 0.56-cm mobile coumadin ridge mass consistent with papillary fibroelastoma. The Amplatzer Amulet was selected for its larger disc geometry to simultaneously occlude the LAA and exclude the mass, with follow-up confirming complete mass exclusion and stability at over 2 years.

DISCUSSION: This is to our knowledge the first reported case of intentional simultaneous LAA occlusion and percutaneous mass exclusion, demonstrating a novel use of device geometry to manage dual embolic risk.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Concurrent LAA and coumadin ridge mass risk can be addressed in a single procedure through deliberate device selection using the Amulet's larger disc.

AI.tldr: 一例高出血风险房颤患者，选用Amplatzer Amulet封堵器同期完成左心耳封堵与菜花状移动性肿物隔绝，随访2年余证实肿物完全隔绝且稳定。
AI.motivation: 菜花状（coumadin ridge）移动性心脏肿物罕见且栓塞风险高，合并房颤时风险叠加；高出血风险患者外科切除禁忌，需探索经皮同期处理双栓塞风险的方案。
AI.method: 病例报告。70岁男性，阵发性房颤，HAS-BLED评分4分，拒绝抗凝，转诊行左心耳封堵。影像学偶然发现菜花状0.56 cm移动性肿物，符合乳头状弹力纤维瘤。选用Amplatzer Amulet封堵器，利用其较大盘面几何结构同期封堵左心耳并隔绝肿物。终点为肿物完全隔绝及随访稳定性。
AI.result: 手术成功，随访超过2年证实肿物完全隔绝且稳定。摘要未报告具体随访影像学数值或统计检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 这是首例有意识同期行左心耳封堵与经皮肿物隔绝的报道，通过选择Amplatzer Amulet较大盘面实现单次手术处理双栓塞风险。对高出血风险、外科禁忌的房颤合并菜花状肿物患者提供了新思路，但为单例经验，需更多病例验证。

summary_zh:
背景：华法林嵴上的活动性心脏肿块罕见，并伴有显著的栓塞风险，同时合并心房颤动会进一步增加风险。对于出血风险高的患者，手术切除可能不可行。

病例摘要：一名70岁男性，患有阵发性心房颤动，HAS-BLED评分为4分，且不愿接受抗凝治疗，被转诊进行左心耳（LAA）封堵。影像学检查偶然发现一个0.56 cm的活动性华法林嵴肿块，符合乳头状弹力纤维瘤。选择Amplatzer Amulet封堵器是因为其较大的盘状几何结构，可同时封堵LAA并隔绝肿块，随访证实肿块完全隔绝且稳定超过2年。

讨论：据我们所知，这是首例报道的故意同时进行LAA封堵和经皮肿块隔绝的病例，展示了利用器械几何结构管理双重栓塞风险的新用途。

要点信息：通过有意选择使用Amulet较大盘的器械，可以在一次手术中同时处理LAA和华法林嵴肿块的风险。

title: Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in an Adult Patient With Fontan Circulation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ventricular arrhythmias are an emerging cause of late morbidity in adults with Fontan circulation, yet catheter ablation strategies in this anatomically complex population remain poorly defined.

CASE SUMMARY: A 25-year-old woman with tricuspid atresia palliated by total cavopulmonary connection presented with sustained ventricular tachycardia. Cardiac magnetic resonance showed circumferential subendocardial fibrosis in the right ventricular outflow tract. Imaging-guided catheter ablation was performed. The cardiac magnetic resonance-defined scar was targeted, abolishing local abnormal ventricular activities. The patient remained arrhythmia-free at the 12-month follow-up.

DISCUSSION: Multimodality imaging facilitated a substrate-based ablation strategy by overcoming the anatomical and hemodynamic constraints inherent to single-ventricle physiology.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Multimodality imaging is essential for ventricular tachycardia substrate characterization in Fontan patients. Right ventricular outflow tract fibrosis may represent the arrhythmogenic substrate even within the rudimentary right ventricle.

AI.tldr: 在Fontan循环成人患者中，多模态影像指导的室速基质消融成功消除右室流出道纤维化相关异常心室活动，12个月无复发。
AI.motivation: 室性心律失常是Fontan循环成人患者晚期发病和死亡的重要原因，但该人群解剖结构复杂，导管消融策略尚不明确，缺乏针对基质标测与消融的明确证据。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为25岁女性，三尖瓣闭锁行全腔静脉肺动脉连接术后，表现为持续性室速。心脏磁共振显示右室流出道环周心内膜下纤维化。行影像指导的导管消融，以磁共振定义的瘢痕为靶点，消融局部异常心室活动。主要终点为消融后室速是否可诱发及随访心律失常复发。
AI.result: 消融成功消除局部异常心室活动，摘要未报告具体电生理参数、消融能量及手术时间。随访12个月，患者无心律失常复发。
AI.conclusion: 多模态影像有助于克服单心室生理的解剖和血流动力学限制，实现基于基质的室速消融；右室流出道纤维化可能是发育不良右室内的致心律失常基质。但本文为单例报告，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：室性心律失常是Fontan循环成人患者晚期发病的一个新出现的原因，然而在这一解剖结构复杂的人群中，导管消融策略仍不明确。

病例摘要：一名25岁女性，因三尖瓣闭锁接受全腔静脉肺动脉连接术姑息治疗后，表现为持续性室性心动过速。心脏磁共振显示右心室流出道存在环周性心内膜下纤维化。遂行影像引导下导管消融。以心脏磁共振所定义的瘢痕为靶点进行消融，消除了局部异常心室电活动。患者在12个月随访时仍无心律失常发作。

讨论：多模态影像有助于制定基于基质的消融策略，其克服了单心室生理所固有的解剖和血流动力学限制。

要点信息：多模态影像对于Fontan患者室性心动过速基质的表征至关重要。即使在发育不良的右心室内，右心室流出道纤维化也可能代表致心律失常基质。

title: Association of the systemic immune-inflammation index with in-hospital malignant ventricular arrhythmia in patients with acute myocardial infarction.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Malignant ventricular arrhythmia (MVA) is a life-threatening in-hospital complication of acute myocardial infarction (AMI). The systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), derived from platelet, neutrophil, and lymphocyte counts, may reflect the inflammatory and thrombotic burden associated with arrhythmic vulnerability. This study investigated the association between SII and in-hospital MVA in patients with AMI.

METHODS: This retrospective study included 13,465 patients hospitalized for AMI at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University from January 2019 to December 2024. SII was calculated as platelet count × neutrophil count/lymphocyte count. Patients were grouped according to SII quartiles, and SII was also analyzed as standardized ln(SII). Logistic regression and restricted cubic spline analyses were used to assess the adjusted association and dose-response pattern, with subgroup and sensitivity analyses used to examine robustness. Separately, the apparent incremental performance of adding SII to a clinical model was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), net reclassification improvement (NRI), and integrated discrimination improvement (IDI).

RESULTS: During hospitalization, 440 patients (3.3%) developed MVA. MVA incidence increased from 1.37% in the lowest SII quartile (Q1) to 6.98% in the highest quartile (Q4). In the fully adjusted model, each 1-SD increase in ln(SII) was associated with higher odds of MVA (odds ratio [OR], 1.48; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.34-1.64; P < 0.001). Compared with Q1, Q4 remained associated with MVA (OR, 2.91; 95% CI, 2.06-4.10; P < 0.001). The apparent AUC was 0.797 for the clinical model and 0.814 after adding standardized ln(SII) (ΔAUC = 0.017).

CONCLUSION: Higher admission SII remained associated with greater odds of in-hospital MVA after multivariable adjustment. The incremental model performance was modest, and external validation is required before its predictive performance and clinical utility can be established.

AI.tldr: 在13465例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，入院SII升高与院内恶性室性心律失常风险独立相关（每1-SD lnSII的OR 1.48），但加入临床模型后预测增益有限（ΔAUC 0.017）。
AI.motivation: 恶性室性心律失常是急性心肌梗死住院期间危及生命的并发症，现有风险分层手段不足。系统性免疫炎症指数（SII）由血小板、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞计数计算而来，可能反映与心律失常易感性相关的炎症与血栓负荷，但其与AMI患者院内MVA的关系尚缺乏大样本证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2019年1月至2024年12月西安交通大学第一附属医院因AMI住院的患者13465例。SII=血小板计数×中性粒细胞计数/淋巴细胞计数，按SII四分位分组，并以标准化ln(SII)连续分析。采用logistic回归和限制性立方样条评估校正后关联及剂量-反应关系，并行亚组与敏感性分析；另用ROC曲线下面积（AUC）、净重分类改善（NRI）和综合判别改善（IDI）评估SII加入临床模型后的增量预测价值。
AI.result: 住院期间440例（3.3%）发生MVA，发生率由SII最低四分位组（Q1）的1.37%升至最高四分位组（Q4）的6.98%。完全校正模型中，ln(SII)每增加1个标准差，MVA风险升高（OR 1.48，95%CI 1.34-1.64，P<0.001）；与Q1相比，Q4的OR为2.91（95%CI 2.06-4.10，P<0.001）。临床模型AUC为0.797，加入标准化ln(SII)后为0.814（ΔAUC=0.017）；摘要未报告NRI与IDI的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 入院时SII升高与AMI患者院内MVA风险增加独立相关，呈剂量-反应关系，但加入临床模型后的增量预测性能有限。该指标或可作为简便的炎症相关风险标志物辅助分层，但尚需外部验证后才能确定其预测价值与临床实用性；回顾性单中心设计及缺乏NRI/IDI数据为其主要局限。

summary_zh:
背景：恶性室性心律失常（MVA）是急性心肌梗死（AMI）住院期间危及生命的并发症。系统性免疫炎症指数（SII）由血小板、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞计数衍生而来，可能反映与心律失常易感性相关的炎症和血栓负荷。本研究探讨了SII与AMI患者住院期间MVA之间的关联。

方法：本回顾性研究纳入2019年1月至2024年12月在西安交通大学第一附属医院因AMI住院的13,465例患者。SII计算为血小板计数×中性粒细胞计数/淋巴细胞计数。根据SII四分位数对患者进行分组，并将SII作为标准化ln(SII)进行分析。采用逻辑回归和限制性立方样条分析评估校正后的关联和剂量-反应模式，并使用亚组和敏感性分析检验稳健性。另外，通过受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、净重分类改善（NRI）和综合判别改善（IDI）评估将SII加入临床模型后的表观增量性能。

结果：住院期间，440例患者（3.3%）发生MVA。MVA发生率从最低SII四分位数（Q1）的1.37%增加至最高四分位数（Q4）的6.98%。在完全校正模型中，ln(SII)每增加1个标准差与MVA风险增高相关（比值比[OR]，1.48；95%置信区间[CI]，1.34-1.64；P < 0.001）。与Q1相比，Q4仍与MVA相关（OR，2.91；95% CI，2.06-4.10；P < 0.001）。临床模型的表观AUC为0.797，加入标准化ln(SII)后为0.814（ΔAUC = 0.017）。

结论：多变量校正后，入院时较高的SII仍与住院期间MVA风险增高相关。模型增量性能有限，在确定其预测性能和临床实用性之前需要进行外部验证。

title: Risk Stratification and Outcomes of Right Atrial Phasic Function in Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy: A Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Advanced arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy is associated with a high risk of malignant ventricular arrhythmias (MVA) and end-stage heart failure (HF). However, the prognostic role of right atrial (RA) mechanics, as quantified by cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR), remains largely unexplored.

METHODS: Consecutive patients with arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy undergoing CMR between 2014 and 2021 were retrospectively included. Demographics, clinical history, and strain parameters were collected. The primary clinical end points were end-stage HF and MVA.

RESULTS: A total of 316 patients (mean age 38±15 years; 66.1% men) were included. Over a median follow-up of 5.3 years, 49 developed end-stage HF and 103 experienced MVA outcomes. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Gray models showed that impaired RA reservoir strain was an independent predictor of end-stage HF (hazard ratio [HR] 0.92, 95% CI 0.89-0.96, P<0.001) and MVA outcomes (subdistribution hazard ratio (sHR) 0.98, 95% CI 0.96-0.99, P=0.025), with added prognostic value beyond clinical and imaging variables, improving the C-statistic to 0.84 and 0.70, respectively. Kaplan-Meier survival curves indicated that RA reservoir strain <18.6% was associated with higher end-stage HF risk, consistent across subgroups regardless of left ventricular involvement (both log-rank P<0.05). The association between RA reservoir strain <23.0% and MVA was significant in the overall cohort (P<0.001) and in patients without left ventricular involvement (P=0.002), but not in those with left ventricular involvement (P=0.08).

CONCLUSIONS: Lower cardiac magnetic resonance-derived RA reservoir strain was independently associated with end-stage HF and MVA in arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy and provided incremental prognostic value beyond conventional risk markers. These findings support RA mechanics as a potential complementary component of multichamber CMR risk assessment, pending external validation.

AI.tldr: 在致心律失常性右心室心肌病患者中，CMR测量的右心房储备应变降低是终末期心衰和恶性室性心律失常的独立预测因子，并提升传统风险模型的预测效能。
AI.motivation: 晚期致心律失常性右心室心肌病与恶性室性心律失常和终末期心衰高风险相关，但右心房力学（通过心脏磁共振量化）的预后价值尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入2014-2021年接受CMR的连续致心律失常性右心室心肌病患者316例，收集体征、临床病史和应变参数。主要终点为终末期心衰和恶性室性心律失常。采用多变量Cox和Fine-Gray模型分析，并评估增量预后价值。
AI.result: 中位随访5.3年，49例发生终末期心衰，103例发生恶性室性心律失常。右心房储备应变降低是终末期心衰的独立预测因子（HR 0.92，95%CI 0.89-0.96，P<0.001）和恶性室性心律失常的独立预测因子（sHR 0.98，95%CI 0.96-0.99，P=0.025），并提升C统计量至0.84和0.70。右心房储备应变<18.6%与终末期心衰风险增高相关，各亚组一致（log-rank P<0.05）。右心房储备应变<23.0%与恶性室性心律失常的关联在总体队列（P<0.001）和无左心室受累患者（P=0.002）中显著，但在左心室受累患者中不显著（P=0.08）。
AI.conclusion: CMR衍生的右心房储备应变降低与致心律失常性右心室心肌病的终末期心衰和恶性室性心律失常独立相关，并提供超越传统风险标志物的增量预后价值。这些发现支持右心房力学作为多心腔CMR风险评估的潜在补充成分，尚待外部验证。

summary_zh:
背景：晚期致心律失常性右心室心肌病与恶性室性心律失常（MVA）和终末期心力衰竭（HF）的高风险相关。然而，通过心脏磁共振成像（CMR）量化的右心房（RA）力学的预后作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

方法：回顾性纳入2014年至2021年间接受CMR的连续致心律失常性右心室心肌病患者。收集人口统计学、临床病史和应变参数。主要临床终点为终末期HF和MVA。

结果：共纳入316例患者（平均年龄38±15岁；66.1%为男性）。在中位随访5.3年期间，49例发生终末期HF，103例发生MVA结局。多变量Cox和Fine-Gray模型显示，RA储备应变受损是终末期HF（风险比[HR] 0.92，95% CI 0.89-0.96，P<0.001）和MVA结局（亚分布风险比（sHR）0.98，95% CI 0.96-0.99，P=0.025）的独立预测因子，在临床和影像变量之外具有附加预后价值，分别将C统计量提高至0.84和0.70。Kaplan-Meier生存曲线表明，RA储备应变<18.6%与较高的终末期HF风险相关，无论左心室是否受累，各亚组均一致（log-rank P均<0.05）。RA储备应变<23.0%与MVA的关联在整个队列（P<0.001）和无左心室受累的患者（P=0.002）中显著，但在左心室受累的患者中不显著（P=0.08）。

结论：较低的心脏磁共振衍生的RA储备应变与致心律失常性右心室心肌病中的终末期HF和MVA独立相关，并在传统风险标志物之外提供了增量预后价值。这些发现支持RA力学作为多腔CMR风险评估的潜在补充组成部分，有待外部验证。

title: Transpulmonary Atrial Pacemaker Implantation in Fontan Circulation With Bilateral Glenn.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with Fontan circulation frequently develop atrial arrhythmias and sinus node dysfunction. Atrial pacing is challenging because conventional transvenous access is limited by complex Fontan anatomy.

CASE SUMMARY: A 20-year-old man with dextroisomerism, bilateral Glenn anastomoses, and Fontan circulation presented with symptomatic sinus node dysfunction and recurrent supraventricular tachycardia. A transpulmonary transvenous approach achieved endocardial atrial lead implantation with excellent pacing parameters. Despite optimized medical therapy, heart failure progressed, and the patient died during transplant evaluation.

DISCUSSION: This case highlights the technical feasibility of transpulmonary endocardial atrial pacing as an alternative to repeat epicardial surgery in selected patients with Fontan circulation. Careful procedural planning, multimodality imaging, and individualized assessment of long-term anticoagulation are important considerations. Despite arrhythmia control, optimized therapy and restoration of atrioventricular synchrony may not prevent heart failure progression, which may be irreversible.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Transpulmonary endocardial atrial pacing is a feasible alternative in carefully selected Patients with Fontan circulation. Sudden cardiac death risk stratification remains limited in this study group.

AI.tldr: 在双侧Glenn吻合的Fontan循环患者中，经肺静脉途径行心内膜心房起搏可行且参数良好，但未能阻止心力衰竭进展。
AI.motivation: Fontan循环患者常合并房性心律失常和窦房结功能障碍，但复杂解剖使传统经静脉途径受限，心外膜起搏需再次手术，经肺静脉心内膜起搏的可行性及临床价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。20岁男性，右异构、双侧Glenn吻合、Fontan循环，因症状性窦房结功能障碍和反复室上性心动过速就诊。采用经肺静脉途径植入心内膜心房导线，评估起搏参数及临床转归。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 经肺静脉途径成功植入心内膜心房导线，起搏参数优良。尽管优化药物治疗，心力衰竭仍进展，患者在心脏移植评估期间死亡。摘要未报告具体起搏参数数值、随访时间及统计学结果。
AI.conclusion: 经肺静脉心内膜心房起搏是特定Fontan循环患者避免再次心外膜手术的可行替代方案，但即使心律失常得到控制，优化治疗和恢复房室同步可能无法阻止不可逆的心力衰竭进展；该组患者心脏性猝死风险分层仍有限。

summary_zh:
背景：Fontan循环患者常发生房性心律失常和窦房结功能障碍。由于复杂的Fontan解剖结构限制了常规经静脉途径，心房起搏具有挑战性。

病例摘要：一名20岁男性，患有右异构、双侧Glenn吻合和Fontan循环，表现为症状性窦房结功能障碍和反复发作的室上性心动过速。经肺静脉途径实现了心内膜心房导线植入，起搏参数良好。尽管优化了药物治疗，心力衰竭仍进展，患者在移植评估期间死亡。

讨论：本病例强调了经肺心内膜心房起搏作为特定Fontan循环患者替代重复心外膜手术的技术可行性。仔细的手术规划、多模态成像和个体化评估长期抗凝是重要考虑因素。尽管心律失常得到控制，优化治疗和恢复房室同步可能无法阻止心力衰竭进展，后者可能不可逆。

要点：经肺心内膜心房起搏是精心选择的Fontan循环患者的可行替代方案。该研究组的心脏性猝死风险分层仍然有限。

title: Transvenous Coil Implant in a Patient With Lateral Tunnel Fontan: The Route Less Traveled.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ventricular arrhythmias occur in approximately 11% of patients who undergo Fontan palliation. Sudden cardiac death, presumably from ventricular arrhythmia, accounts for approximately 10%-20% of the overall mortality among these patients. Implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) implantation in these patients is challenging because of limited transvenous access to the subpulmonary ventricle.

CASE SUMMARY: A 41-year-old woman who underwent Fontan palliation later developed complete heart block and underwent epicardial pacemaker implantation at the age of 36 years. She developed symptomatic ventricular tachycardia and worsening heart failure with planned heart/lung transplant listing. She was considered to be at prohibitive risk for epicardial defibrillator and failed subcutaneous ICD screening. We describe a transvenous ICD upgrade using a hemiazygos vein coil, inframammary generator, and lead extenders for existing epicardial leads.

DISCUSSION: This case highlights the feasibility of hemiazygos vein coil placement in combination with an inframammary generator pocket in selected patients with Fontan.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: The hemiazygos vein may be a viable option for transvenous coil placement in these patients.

AI.tldr: 在侧隧道Fontan术后患者中，经半奇静脉植入线圈并结合乳房下发电机口袋，可安全实现经静脉ICD升级。
AI.motivation: Fontan术后患者室性心律失常发生率约11%，心源性猝死占总死亡率10%-20%，但经静脉ICD植入因下肺静脉心室通路受限而困难，现有心外膜和皮下ICD方案存在局限。
AI.method: 病例报告：41岁女性，36岁时因完全性心脏传导阻滞植入心外膜起搏器，后出现症状性室性心动过速和心力衰竭加重，计划心肺移植，被评估为心外膜除颤器风险过高且皮下ICD筛查失败。采用半奇静脉线圈、乳房下发电机口袋及现有心外膜导线延长器进行经静脉ICD升级。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体手术成功率、并发症或随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于选择性Fontan患者，半奇静脉线圈联合乳房下发电机口袋是可行的经静脉ICD升级方案，为传统路径不可行的患者提供了新选择，但需更多病例验证其安全性和有效性。

summary_zh:
背景：在接受Fontan姑息手术的患者中，约11%会出现室性心律失常。推测由室性心律失常导致的心源性猝死约占这些患者总体死亡率的10%-20%。由于经静脉途径进入肺动脉下心室受限，在这些患者中植入植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）具有挑战性。

病例摘要：一名41岁女性，曾接受Fontan姑息手术，后发生完全性心脏传导阻滞，并于36岁时接受了心外膜起搏器植入。她出现了症状性室性心动过速和心力衰竭恶化，已被列入心脏/肺移植名单。她被认为心外膜除颤器风险过高，且皮下ICD筛查未通过。我们描述了一例经静脉ICD升级，使用半奇静脉线圈、乳房下发电机和用于现有心外膜导线的导线延长器。

讨论：本病例突出了在部分Fontan患者中，半奇静脉线圈放置联合乳房下发电机囊袋的可行性。

要点信息：对于这些患者，半奇静脉可能是经静脉线圈放置的可行选择。

title: Long-Term Prognostic Value of Scar Characteristics in Cardiac Magnetic Resonance to Predict Appropriate Therapies in Primary Prevention.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) with late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) provides unique insights into ventricular arrhythmogenic substrate, although few studies have analyzed its long-term value in patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) for primary prevention.

OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study was to evaluate the role of LGE characteristics in stratifying arrhythmogenic risk in patients with ICD implantation for primary prevention over long-term follow-up.

METHODS: This was a prospective study, between 2011 and 2017, in which 226 patients who underwent LGE CMR before ICD implantation for primary prevention were consecutively enrolled. Dedicated software (ADAS 3D) was used to quantify LGE, border zone, core, and conducting channels (CCs).

RESULTS: The median age was 62.9 years (Q1-Q3: 55.4-68.5 years), with 52% of participants (n = 104) with ischemic cardiomyopathy and a median MADIT (Multicenter Automatic Defibrillator Implantation Trial) score of 54 (Q1-Q3: 42-64). After a median follow-up period of 8.1 years (Q1-Q3: 6.2-10 years), 59 patients (29.5%) reached the primary endpoint (appropriate ICD therapy). LGE mass >10 g (HR: 3.58; 95% CI: 1.29-9.93; P = 0.014), CCs (HR: 3.42; 95% CI: 1.69-6.96; P = 0.009), and the presence of both LGE mass >10 g and CCs (34.92% vs 5.55%; HR: 4.65; 95% CI: 1.46-14.8; P = 0.009) were strongly associated with the primary endpoint. Patients without CCs and with LGE mass < 10 g had a very low rate of appropriate therapies (negative predictive value = 92%). LGE parameters remained independently associated with the primary endpoint after adjustment for MADIT score.

CONCLUSIONS: The characteristics of potential arrhythmia substrate assessed using LGE CMR are potent predictors of ventricular arrhythmias after ICD implantation for the primary prevention of sudden death.

AI.tldr: 在226例一级预防ICD植入患者中，LGE质量>10g和传导通道是长期恰当ICD治疗的独立预测因子，两者均无者恰当治疗率极低（阴性预测值92%）。
AI.motivation: CMR延迟钆增强（LGE）可无创评估室性心律失常基质，但其在ICD一级预防患者中的长期预后价值研究较少，需要更精准的风险分层工具来指导ICD植入决策。
AI.method: 前瞻性研究，2011-2017年连续纳入226例一级预防ICD植入前接受LGE CMR的患者，使用ADAS 3D软件量化LGE质量、边界区、核心区和传导通道（CCs）。主要终点为恰当ICD治疗，中位随访8.1年，采用Cox回归分析LGE参数与终点的关联，并校正MADIT评分。
AI.result: 中位年龄62.9岁，52%为缺血性心肌病，中位MADIT评分54。随访期间59例（29.5%）达到主要终点。LGE质量>10g（HR 3.58；95%CI 1.29-9.93；P=0.014）、CCs（HR 3.42；95%CI 1.69-6.96；P=0.009）及两者并存（34.92% vs 5.55%；HR 4.65；95%CI 1.46-14.8；P=0.009）与主要终点强相关。无CCs且LGE质量<10g者恰当治疗率极低（阴性预测值92%）。校正MADIT评分后LGE参数仍独立相关。
AI.conclusion: LGE CMR评估的心律失常基质特征是一级预防ICD植入后室性心律失常的强预测因子，可优化风险分层。无CCs且LGE质量<10g的患者可能从ICD获益有限，但需前瞻性验证以指导临床决策。

summary_zh:
背景：带有晚期钆增强（LGE）的心脏磁共振（CMR）可提供对室性心律失常基质的独特见解，尽管很少有研究分析其在植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）用于一级预防患者中的长期价值。

目的：本研究旨在评估LGE特征在长期随访中对ICD植入用于一级预防患者心律失常风险分层的作用。

方法：这是一项前瞻性研究，于2011年至2017年间连续纳入226例在ICD植入用于一级预防前接受LGE CMR的患者。使用专用软件（ADAS 3D）量化LGE、边界区、核心和传导通道（CCs）。

结果：中位年龄为62.9岁（Q1-Q3：55.4-68.5岁），52%的参与者（n = 104）患有缺血性心肌病，中位MADIT（多中心自动除颤器植入试验）评分为54（Q1-Q3：42-64）。在中位随访期8.1年（Q1-Q3：6.2-10年）后，59例患者（29.5%）达到主要终点（适当的ICD治疗）。LGE质量 >10 g（HR：3.58；95% CI：1.29-9.93；P = 0.014）、CCs（HR：3.42；95% CI：1.69-6.96；P = 0.009）以及同时存在LGE质量 >10 g和CCs（34.92% vs 5.55%；HR：4.65；95% CI：1.46-14.8；P = 0.009）与主要终点强烈相关。无CCs且LGE质量 < 10 g的患者适当治疗率非常低（阴性预测值 = 92%）。调整MADIT评分后，LGE参数仍与主要终点独立相关。

结论：使用LGE CMR评估的潜在心律失常基质特征是ICD植入用于心脏性猝死一级预防后室性心律失常的有力预测因素。

title: Association of Left Ventricular Epicardial Adipose Tissue and Lipomatous Metaplasia With Ventricular Tachycardia Circuitry and Recurrence Following Ablation in Patients With Non-Ischemic Cardiomyopathy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with nonischemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) have complex intramural ventricular tachycardia (VT) circuitry and relatively high postablation recurrences.

OBJECTIVES: This study evaluated the association of left ventricular epicardial adipose tissue (LV EAT) and lipomatous metaplasia (LM) with critical VT circuitry and postablation VT recurrence in patients with NICM.

METHODS: In this retrospective study, we quantified LV EAT and LM via cardiac contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) in a cohort of consecutive patients with NICM before VT ablation. CECT image registration with VT critical sites in electroanatomic mapping was performed in a subset. Mixed-effects and subdistribution proportional hazard models were used to examine the association of image features with VT circuitry elements and outcomes, respectively.

RESULTS: In 48 patients with coregistered CECT-electroanatomic mapping, segmental maximal EAT thickness was associated with critical VT sites (OR: 1.36 per mm increase; P < 0.001), and a threshold of >4.7 mm EAT achieved 72% sensitivity and 71% specificity (OR: 2.15; P = 0.006) for VT site identification. This association remained significant after adjusting for LM, with a significant EAT-LM interaction (P = 0.027). Among all 119 patients, 52 experienced VT recurrence during a median follow-up of 1.7 years (Q1-Q3: 0.7-4.0). Lower LV EAT attenuation was independently associated with time to VT recurrence (subdistribution HR: 1.04 per 1 HU decrease; P = 0.012) after multivariable adjustment including LM and a significant LM interaction (P = 0.020).

CONCLUSIONS: LV EAT density and thickness are associated with VT circuitry and postablation recurrence in patients with NICM, and demonstrate a significant statistical interaction with LM.

AI.tldr: 在非缺血性心肌病患者中，左室心外膜脂肪厚度与VT关键位点相关，低密度与消融后VT复发独立相关，且与脂肪瘤样化生存在交互作用。
AI.motivation: 非缺血性心肌病患者VT环路复杂且心壁内分布，消融后复发率较高；既往对左室心外膜脂肪及脂肪瘤样化生与VT环路及复发的关系证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，连续纳入119例NICM患者，消融前行心脏增强CT定量左室心外膜脂肪（EAT）和脂肪瘤样化生（LM）；其中48例将CT与电解剖标测VT关键位点配准。采用混合效应模型和竞争风险比例风险模型分析影像特征与VT环路及复发的关系。
AI.result: 48例配准患者中，节段最大EAT厚度与VT关键位点相关（每增加1mm，OR 1.36，P<0.001）；EAT>4.7mm识别VT位点的敏感性72%、特异性71%（OR 2.15，P=0.006），校正LM后仍显著，EAT-LM交互P=0.027。全部119例中位随访1.7年，52例VT复发；校正LM后，较低EAT密度与复发独立相关（每降低1HU，亚分布HR 1.04，P=0.012），LM交互P=0.020。
AI.conclusion: 左室EAT密度和厚度与NICM患者VT环路及消融后复发相关，并与LM存在统计学交互作用；提示术前CT影像特征可能辅助VT消融策略，但回顾性设计及样本量有限，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：非缺血性心肌病（NICM）患者具有复杂的壁内室性心动过速（VT）环路，且消融后复发率相对较高。

目的：本研究评估左心室心外膜脂肪组织（LV EAT）和脂肪瘤样化生（LM）与NICM患者关键VT环路及消融后VT复发的关联。

方法：在这项回顾性研究中，我们通过心脏对比增强计算机断层扫描（CECT）对一组连续NICM患者在VT消融前量化了LV EAT和LM。在部分患者中进行了CECT图像与电解剖标测中VT关键位点的配准。采用混合效应模型和子分布比例风险模型分别检验图像特征与VT环路元素及结局的关联。

结果：在48例具有CECT-电解剖标测配准的患者中，节段最大EAT厚度与关键VT位点相关（OR：每增加1 mm为1.36；P < 0.001），且EAT阈值>4.7 mm对VT位点识别的敏感性为72%、特异性为71%（OR：2.15；P = 0.006）。在调整LM后，这种关联仍然显著，且EAT-LM交互作用显著（P = 0.027）。在所有119例患者中，中位随访1.7年（Q1-Q3：0.7-4.0）期间有52例发生VT复发。在多变量调整包括LM及显著的LM交互作用（P = 0.020）后，较低的LV EAT衰减与VT复发时间独立相关（子分布HR：每降低1 HU为1.04；P = 0.012）。

结论：LV EAT密度和厚度与NICM患者的VT环路及消融后复发相关，并与LM显示出显著的统计学交互作用。

title: Relaxin-2 reverses diastolic dysfunction and suppresses sustained arrhythmias in a rat model of Heart Failure with preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF).
summary:
AIMS: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) afflicts millions annually and current treatments provide symptomatic relief. The goal is to test the effects of synthetic human Relaxin-2 (RLX) on diastolic dysfunction (DD) and arrhythmia vulnerability.

METHODS AND RESULTS: Male ZSF1 rats were placed on a normal diet (ND, N = 8 controls) or a high-fat diet (HFD, N = 11), resulting in the development of DD in 11-weeks, based on serial echocardiograms (enlarged left atrium (LA), wall thickness, doppler flow: E/e'). Once HFpEF was confirmed, ND and HFpEF rats were randomly treated with Relaxin (400 µg/kg/day RLX, N = 6) or the vehicle (N = 5) for 2-weeks using implanted minipumps. Echocardiograms were repeated for 2 more weeks, then hearts were isolated, optically mapped, subjected to programmed electrical stimulation (PES) and tissues dissected for immuno-fluorescence (IF), and qPCR analysis. Circulating levels of glucose, RLX and NT-pro-ANP were measured, pre- and post-treatment. Echocardiograms indicated that RLX reversed DD by reducing LA dimensions and E/e'. Optical mapping showed that vehicle-treated, ND rats (N = 3) had non-sustained atrial (1/3), and ventricular (3/3) arrhythmias and RLX-treatment reduced them to 0/3 and 1/3, respectively. Vehicle-treated, HFD rats had non-sustained (2/5) and sustained (2/5) atrial and ventricular arrhythmias (N = 5). RLX-treatment (N = 6) suppressed sustained atrial and ventricular arrhythmias (0/6) but not non-sustained atrial (2/6) and ventricular (3/6) arrhythmias. RLX tended to increase conduction velocity (CV), particularly at short cycle lengths consistent with increased Nav1.5, Connexin-43, β-catenin and Wnt1 expression, based on IF. There were no significant changes in fibrosis in this HFpEF model. NT-pro-ANP was elevated in HFpEF and reduced towards control values by RLX. qPCR analysis showed that RLX decreased Dickkopf (DKK1) and Matrix Metallopeptidase 1a (MMP1A) genes and increased SCN5A expression compared to vehicle (N = 6 and 5, respectively).

CONCLUSIONS: The ZSF1 model showed indications of HFpEF, including DD, enlargement of the LA, hemodynamic stress, increased vulnerability to sustained AF and VF, and elevated glucose and blood pressure. RLX treatment largely reversed DD, hemodynamic stress, and suppressed sustained arrhythmias. RLX elicited cardiac genomic changes, most likely through Wnt/canonical signaling, demonstrating RLX's potential as a therapy for HFpEF.

AI.tldr: 在ZSF1大鼠HFpEF模型中，重组人松弛素-2治疗2周可逆转舒张功能障碍并抑制持续性房性和室性心律失常，其机制可能与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路介导的传导速度改善有关。
AI.motivation: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）每年影响数百万人，当前治疗仅能缓解症状，且该人群心律失常易感性增加，但缺乏针对舒张功能障碍和心律失常的有效疗法。本研究旨在探讨松弛素-2（RLX）对HFpEF大鼠模型舒张功能障碍和心律失常易感性的影响。
AI.method: 研究采用雄性ZSF1大鼠，分为正常饮食对照组（ND，N=8）和高脂饮食HFpEF组（HFD，N=11），通过系列超声心动图（左房增大、室壁增厚、E/e'升高）在11周时确认舒张功能障碍。随后ND和HFpEF大鼠随机接受RLX（400 µg/kg/day，N=6）或溶剂（N=5）治疗2周（植入微泵），复查超声后分离心脏，进行光学标测和程序电刺激（PES），并取组织行免疫荧光和qPCR分析。检测循环葡萄糖、RLX和NT-pro-ANP水平。
AI.result: RLX治疗逆转了舒张功能障碍，表现为左房尺寸和E/e'降低。光学标测显示，溶剂处理的ND大鼠（N=3）有非持续性房性（1/3）和室性（3/3）心律失常，RLX治疗减少至0/3和1/3；溶剂处理的HFD大鼠（N=5）有非持续性（2/5）和持续性（2/5）房性和室性心律失常，RLX治疗（N=6）抑制了持续性房性和室性心律失常（0/6），但非持续性房性（2/6）和室性（3/6）心律失常仍存在。RLX有增加传导速度的趋势，尤其在短周期长度时，与Nav1.5、Connexin-43、β-catenin和Wnt1表达增加一致。该HFpEF模型纤维化无显著变化。HFpEF中NT-pro-ANP升高，RLX治疗后降低至接近对照水平。qPCR显示RLX降低DKK1和MMP1A基因表达，增加SCN5A表达（N=6和5）。
AI.conclusion: ZSF1模型表现出HFpEF特征，包括舒张功能障碍、左房增大、血流动力学应激、持续性AF和VF易感性增加、血糖和血压升高。RLX治疗可大部分逆转舒张功能障碍和血流动力学应激，并抑制持续性心律失常。RLX引起心脏基因组改变，可能通过Wnt/经典信号通路，显示其作为HFpEF治疗的潜力。

summary_zh:
目的：射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）每年影响数百万人，目前的治疗仅能提供症状缓解。本研究旨在测试合成人松弛素-2（RLX）对舒张功能障碍（DD）和心律失常易感性的影响。

方法与结果：雄性ZSF1大鼠被给予正常饮食（ND，N=8只对照）或高脂饮食（HFD，N=11），基于系列超声心动图（左心房（LA）扩大、壁厚度、多普勒血流：E/e'），在11周时导致DD的发展。一旦确认HFpEF，ND和HFpEF大鼠使用植入式微泵随机接受松弛素（400 µg/kg/天 RLX，N=6）或溶媒（N=5）治疗2周。重复超声心动图2周，然后分离心脏，进行光学标测，接受程序电刺激（PES），并解剖组织进行免疫荧光（IF）和qPCR分析。在治疗前后测量循环中葡萄糖、RLX和NT-pro-ANP水平。超声心动图表明，RLX通过减少LA尺寸和E/e'逆转DD。光学标测显示，溶媒治疗的ND大鼠（N=3）有非持续性房性（1/3）和室性（3/3）心律失常，RLX治疗分别将其减少至0/3和1/3。溶媒治疗的HFD大鼠有非持续性（2/5）和持续性（2/5）房性和室性心律失常（N=5）。RLX治疗（N=6）抑制了持续性房性和室性心律失常（0/6），但未抑制非持续性房性（2/6）和室性（3/6）心律失常。基于IF，RLX倾向于增加传导速度（CV），特别是在短周期长度时，与Nav1.5、Connexin-43、β-catenin和Wnt1表达增加一致。在这个HFpEF模型中，纤维化没有显著变化。HFpEF中NT-pro-ANP升高，RLX使其降低至接近对照值。qPCR分析显示，与溶媒相比，RLX降低了Dickkopf（DKK1）和基质金属肽酶1a（MMP1A）基因，并增加了SCN5A表达（分别为N=6和5）。

结论：ZSF1模型显示出HFpEF的指征，包括DD、LA扩大、血流动力学应激、对持续性AF和VF的易感性增加，以及葡萄糖和血压升高。RLX治疗在很大程度上逆转了DD、血流动力学应激，并抑制了持续性心律失常。RLX引起了心脏基因组变化，最可能通过Wnt/经典信号传导，证明RLX作为HFpEF治疗的潜力。

title: Rationale and Design of a Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Trial: LEAP-Block.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrioventricular block with normal cardiac function is common with right ventricular pacing, which raises risks of pacing-induced cardiomyopathy and symptomatic heart failure in some patients with high pacing burden. Left bundle-branch area pacing demonstrates protective potential to reduce the risk of heart failure on the basis of observational studies. Evidence from a large multicenter randomized controlled trial remains limited.

METHODS: The LEAP-Block (Impact of Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing Versus Right Ventricular Pacing in Atrioventricular Block) study is a prospective multicenter, investigator-initiated randomized controlled trial aiming to verify the hypothesis that left bundle-branch area pacing might have superior impact to right ventricular pacing in reducing the risk of cardiovascular events in patients with atrioventricular block requiring high burden of ventricular pacing and left ventricular ejection fraction ≥50%. A total of 484 patients will be randomized to either left bundle-branch area pacing or right ventricular pacing (1:1). The primary end point is the composite events of all-cause death, heart failure events, and upgrade to biventricular pacing-delivered cardiac resynchronization therapy during at least 24 months of follow-up. Secondary end points include changes in echocardiographic, electrocardiographic, and pacing parameters and device-related complications.

CONCLUSIONS: The LEAP-Block study aims to compare the impact of left bundle-branch area pacing versus conventional right ventricular pacing in patients with atrioventricular block and preserved cardiac function with respect to midterm clinical outcomes. This trial will provide high-quality evidence for the selection of optimal pacing strategies in clinical practice.

REGISTRATION INFORMATION: clinicaltrials.gov. Identifier: NCT04730921.

AI.tldr: LEAP-Block 试验将验证左束支区域起搏相比右心室起搏能否降低房室传导阻滞且左室射血分数≥50%患者的心血管事件风险，计划纳入484例。
AI.motivation: 房室传导阻滞伴正常心功能的患者接受右心室起搏时，高起搏负荷可能增加起搏诱导性心肌病和症状性心衰风险。观察性研究提示左束支区域起搏具有保护潜力，但缺乏大型多中心随机对照试验证据。
AI.method: LEAP-Block 为前瞻性、多中心、研究者发起的随机对照试验，计划纳入484例需高比例心室起搏且左室射血分数≥50%的房室传导阻滞患者，按1:1随机分配至左束支区域起搏组或右心室起搏组。主要终点为至少24个月随访期间全因死亡、心衰事件及升级为双心室起搏心脏再同步治疗组成的复合终点；次要终点包括超声心动图、心电图和起搏参数变化及器械相关并发症。
AI.result: 摘要未报告试验结果，仅描述研究设计与终点。
AI.conclusion: LEAP-Block 旨在比较左束支区域起搏与常规右心室起搏在房室传导阻滞且心功能保留患者中的中期临床结局，将为临床起搏策略选择提供高质量证据；目前尚缺乏结果数据，其结论有待试验完成后公布。

summary_zh:
背景：在右心室起搏中，伴正常心功能的房室传导阻滞较为常见，这增加了高起搏负荷患者发生起搏诱导性心肌病和症状性心力衰竭的风险。基于观察性研究，左束支区域起搏显示出降低心力衰竭风险的保护潜力。来自大型多中心随机对照试验的证据仍然有限。

方法：LEAP-Block（左束支区域起搏对比右心室起搏在房室传导阻滞中的影响）研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、研究者发起的随机对照试验，旨在验证以下假设：对于需要高负荷心室起搏且左心室射血分数≥50%的房室传导阻滞患者，左束支区域起搏在降低心血管事件风险方面可能优于右心室起搏。共484例患者将被随机分配至左束支区域起搏组或右心室起搏组（1:1）。主要终点为至少24个月随访期间的全因死亡、心力衰竭事件和升级为双心室起搏心脏再同步治疗复合事件。次要终点包括超声心动图、心电图和起搏参数的变化以及器械相关并发症。

结论：LEAP-Block研究旨在比较左束支区域起搏与传统右心室起搏在房室传导阻滞且心功能保留患者中对中期临床结局的影响。该试验将为临床实践中最佳起搏策略的选择提供高质量证据。

注册信息：clinicaltrials.gov。标识符：NCT04730921。

title: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Postarrest Cardiac Procedures for Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Effective postarrest care facilitates optimal outcomes for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. Relatively little research has evaluated whether there may be racial or ethnic disparities in the workup and management of the patient post arrest.

METHODS: We retrospectively studied out-of-hospital cardiac arrests using the TriNetX research database. We defined out-of-hospital cardiac arrest as any emergency department visit (2013-2024) with a diagnosis of cardiac arrest and included patients who survived to admission. Multivariate adjusted logistic regression was used to compare rates of the following cardiac interventions across race or ethnicity: (1) echocardiography; (2) left heart catheterization; (3) percutaneous coronary intervention; (4) ventricular assist device placement; and (5) automated implantable cardioverter-defibrillator placement.

RESULTS: A total of 58 394 cases of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest met inclusion criteria. Compared with White patients (left heart catheterization: 13.9%, percutaneous coronary intervention: 7.1%, ventricular assist device: 3.0%, automated implantable cardioverter-defibrillator: 0.9%), Black patients had lower odds of receiving left heart catheterization (7.2%, adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 0.60 [95% CI, 0.55-0.64]), percutaneous coronary intervention (2.6%, aOR, 0.47 [95% CI, 0.42-0.53]), ventricular assist device placement (1.6%, aOR, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.60-0.80]), and automated implantable cardioverter-defibrillator placement (0.4%, aOR, 0.53 [95% CI, 0.41-0.70]). Hispanic/Latino patients were also less likely to receive left heart catheterization (8.9%, aOR, 0.72 [95% CI, 0.64-0.80]), percutaneous coronary intervention (3.7%, aOR, 0.63 [95% CI, 0.53-0.74]), and automated implantable cardioverter-defibrillator placement (0.4%, aOR, 0.52 [95% CI, 0.33-0.81]).

CONCLUSIONS: Our large multicenter analysis identifies racial or ethnic disparities in postarrest cardiac workup and management. Further research is needed to identify potential causes for these disparities with the hope of developing strategies to address them.

AI.tldr: 在58,394例院外心脏骤停存活入院患者中，黑人和西班牙裔/拉丁裔患者接受左心导管、PCI、VAD和ICD的比例显著低于白人患者。
AI.motivation: 有效的心脏骤停后治疗可改善院外心脏骤停患者的预后，但既往研究较少评估骤停后检查与治疗过程中是否存在种族或民族差异，这一证据缺口可能影响医疗公平性。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，使用TriNetX研究数据库，纳入2013-2024年急诊就诊并诊断为心脏骤停且存活至入院的患者，共58,394例。采用多因素校正logistic回归比较不同种族/民族接受以下心脏干预的比例：超声心动图、左心导管、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）、心室辅助装置（VAD）植入和自动植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）植入。
AI.result: 与白人患者相比（左心导管13.9%、PCI 7.1%、VAD 3.0%、ICD 0.9%），黑人患者接受左心导管（7.2%，aOR 0.60，95%CI 0.55-0.64）、PCI（2.6%，aOR 0.47，95%CI 0.42-0.53）、VAD植入（1.6%，aOR 0.70，95%CI 0.60-0.80）和ICD植入（0.4%，aOR 0.53，95%CI 0.41-0.70）的 odds 均显著降低。西班牙裔/拉丁裔患者接受左心导管（8.9%，aOR 0.72，95%CI 0.64-0.80）、PCI（3.7%，aOR 0.63，95%CI 0.53-0.74）和ICD植入（0.4%，aOR 0.52，95%CI 0.33-0.81）的 odds 也显著降低。超声心动图相关结果摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 这项大型多中心分析揭示了院外心脏骤停后心脏检查与治疗中存在种族或民族差异，提示需要进一步研究差异原因并制定干预策略以促进医疗公平；但研究为回顾性设计，可能存在未测量混杂，且摘要未报告超声心动图结果及具体机制。

summary_zh:
背景：有效的复苏后治疗有助于院外心脏骤停患者获得最佳结局。相对较少的研究评估了心脏骤停后患者的检查和治疗中是否存在种族或民族差异。

方法：我们使用TriNetX研究数据库对院外心脏骤停进行了回顾性研究。我们将院外心脏骤停定义为任何急诊科就诊（2013-2024年）并诊断为心脏骤停，并纳入存活至入院的患者。使用多变量调整逻辑回归比较不同种族或民族接受以下心脏干预的比率：（1）超声心动图；（2）左心导管检查；（3）经皮冠状动脉介入治疗；（4）心室辅助装置置入；（5）自动植入式心律转复除颤器置入。

结果：共有58 394例院外心脏骤停符合纳入标准。与白人患者（左心导管检查：13.9%，经皮冠状动脉介入治疗：7.1%，心室辅助装置：3.0%，自动植入式心律转复除颤器：0.9%）相比，黑人患者接受左心导管检查（7.2%，调整比值比[aOR]，0.60 [95% CI，0.55-0.64]）、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（2.6%，aOR，0.47 [95% CI，0.42-0.53]）、心室辅助装置置入（1.6%，aOR，0.70 [95% CI，0.60-0.80]）和自动植入式心律转复除颤器置入（0.4%，aOR，0.53 [95% CI，0.41-0.70]）的几率较低。西班牙裔/拉丁裔患者接受左心导管检查（8.9%，aOR，0.72 [95% CI，0.64-0.80]）、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（3.7%，aOR，0.63 [95% CI，0.53-0.74]）和自动植入式心律转复除颤器置入（0.4%，aOR，0.52 [95% CI，0.33-0.81]）的可能性也较低。

结论：我们的大型多中心分析确定了复苏后心脏检查和治疗中的种族或民族差异。需要进一步研究以确定这些差异的潜在原因，以期制定解决这些差异的策略。

title: Perceived Social Support Among Patients with Permanent Cardiac Pacemakers.
summary:
In recent years, the number of implanted permanent cardiac pacemakers (PPMs) has been steadily increasing. Perceived social support is a source that enhances device acceptance, overall well-being, and quality of life among PPM recipients. This study aimed to explore perceived social support and its associated factors. In this cross-sectional study, 120 patients with PPMs were enrolled. Data were collected through interviews using the Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support (MSPSS) for assessing perceived social support from family, significant others, and friends. Patient characteristics were also recorded. Statistical significance was defined as P < .05. The majority of participants were men (58.3%) and had their pacemaker implanted for >5 years (46.7%). The median scores on the MSPSS subscales were 28 points for significant others, 28 points for family, and 16 points for friends, indicating high levels of perceived social support within the possible score range of 4-28 points. Scores on the MSPSS were high for significant others (mean ± standard deviation, 27.2 ± 2.7 points; range, 4-28 points) and family (27.1 ± 2.7 points; range, 4-28 points), while support from friends was comparatively lower (16.7 ± 8.6 points; range, 4-28 points). Statistically significant associations were observed between support from significant others and both age (P = .049) and marital status (P = .010). Family support was significantly associated with marital status (P = .007), years since pacemaker implantation (P = .027), and patients' self-reported level of health information (P = .017). Support from friends was significantly associated with age (P = .045), marital status (P = .012), comorbidity (P = .028), and device acceptance (P = .025). In conclusion, higher perceived social support was reported from family and significant others compared with friends. Marital status, age, comorbidity, years since pacemaker implantation, patients' level of health information, comorbidity, and device acceptance were associated with social support levels.

CLINICAL IMPACT: This study provides important insights into the social support experienced by patients with permanent pacemakers. While support from significant others and family was high, support from friends was lower, highlighting differences in the sources of social support. Importantly, social support was associated with key patient characteristics, including age, marital status, comorbidity, years since implantation, perceived health information, and device acceptance. These findings suggest that social support is a multidimensional aspect of pacemaker care and that some patients may be more vulnerable to reduced support. Recognizing recipients support needs and strengthening communication, patient and family education, and social connectedness may facilitate better adaptation to the pacemaker and promote patients' overall well-being. The findings highlight the need to incorporate assessment of social support into patient-centered pacemaker follow-up and nursing care.

AI.tldr: 横断面研究纳入120例永久起搏器患者，家庭与重要他人社会支持评分高（约27/28分），朋友支持较低（16.7分），且支持水平与年龄、婚姻状况、合并症、植入年限及设备接受度相关。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器植入数量逐年增加，感知社会支持被认为可提升设备接受度、整体健康感和生活质量，但起搏器患者社会支持的具体水平及其相关因素尚缺乏系统描述，既往证据不足以指导以患者为中心的随访与护理。
AI.method: 单中心横断面研究，纳入120例永久起搏器植入患者，通过访谈使用多维感知社会支持量表（MSPSS）评估来自家庭、重要他人和朋友三个维度的社会支持（各维度分值范围4-28分），同时记录患者特征；以P<0.05为统计学显著，分析社会支持与患者特征之间的关联。
AI.result: 受试者以男性为主（58.3%），46.7%植入起搏器超过5年。MSPSS中位分：重要他人28分、家庭28分、朋友16分；均值±标准差分别为重要他人27.2±2.7分、家庭27.1±2.7分、朋友16.7±8.6分。重要他人支持与年龄（P=0.049）和婚姻状况（P=0.010）显著相关；家庭支持与婚姻状况（P=0.007）、植入年限（P=0.027）和自评健康信息水平（P=0.017）相关；朋友支持与年龄（P=0.045）、婚姻状况（P=0.012）、合并症（P=0.028）和设备接受度（P=0.025）相关。摘要未报告效应量及95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 起搏器患者感知的家庭与重要他人支持较高，朋友支持相对较低，且支持水平与年龄、婚姻状况、合并症、植入年限、健康信息水平和设备接受度相关。提示应将社会支持评估纳入以患者为中心的起搏器随访与护理，关注支持薄弱人群并加强沟通与患者教育；但本研究为单中心横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，样本量有限，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
近年来，植入永久性心脏起搏器（PPM）的数量稳步增加。感知社会支持是一种资源，可增强PPM接受者的设备接受度、整体福祉和生活质量。本研究旨在探讨感知社会支持及其相关因素。在这项横断面研究中，纳入了120名PPM患者。通过访谈使用多维感知社会支持量表（MSPSS）收集数据，以评估来自家庭、重要他人和朋友的社会支持。同时记录患者特征。统计显著性定义为P < .05。大多数参与者为男性（58.3%），且起搏器植入时间>5年（46.7%）。MSPSS子量表的中位分数为：重要他人28分，家庭28分，朋友16分，表明在4-28分的可能得分范围内感知社会支持水平较高。MSPSS得分在重要他人（均值±标准差，27.2 ± 2.7分；范围4-28分）和家庭（27.1 ± 2.7分；范围4-28分）方面较高，而朋友支持相对较低（16.7 ± 8.6分；范围4-28分）。观察到重要他人支持与年龄（P = .049）和婚姻状况（P = .010）之间存在统计学显著关联。家庭支持与婚姻状况（P = .007）、起搏器植入年数（P = .027）和患者自报健康信息水平（P = .017）显著相关。朋友支持与年龄（P = .045）、婚姻状况（P = .012）、合并症（P = .028）和设备接受度（P = .025）显著相关。总之，与朋友相比，来自家庭和重要他人的感知社会支持更高。婚姻状况、年龄、合并症、起搏器植入年数、患者健康信息水平、合并症和设备接受度与社会支持水平相关。

临床影响：本研究为永久性起搏器患者所经历的社会支持提供了重要见解。虽然来自重要他人和家庭的支持较高，但朋友支持较低，突显了社会支持来源的差异。重要的是，社会支持与关键患者特征相关，包括年龄、婚姻状况、合并症、植入年数、感知健康信息和设备接受度。这些发现表明，社会支持是起搏器护理的多维方面，一些患者可能更容易受到支持减少的影响。认识到接受者的支持需求并加强沟通、患者和家庭教育以及社会联系，可能有助于更好地适应起搏器并促进患者的整体福祉。研究结果强调需要将社会支持评估纳入以患者为中心的起搏器随访和护理中。

title: Leadless Pacing Dyssynchrony and Diastolic Mitral Regurgitation Rescued by Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Dual-chamber leadless pacing depends on beat-to-beat implant-to-implant communication; heart failure-related geometric changes may expose limited communication reserve.

CASE SUMMARY: A 92-year-old woman with complete atrioventricular block developed heart failure 9 months after dual-chamber leadless pacemaker implantation, with reduced atrial-to-ventricular (A-to-V) throughput, atrioventricular dissociation, ventricular functional and diastolic mitral regurgitation, and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction. Decongestion was accompanied by shortening of the projected interdevice distance, improvement in A-to-V throughput and atrioventricular synchrony, and disappearance of diastolic mitral regurgitation. Heart failure recurred despite preserved throughput and continued medical therapy. Upgrade to a transvenous dual-chamber pacemaker with left bundle branch area pacing narrowed the QRS and improved left ventricular function and mitral regurgitation.

DISCUSSION: Pacing-induced cardiomyopathy appeared to be the dominant substrate, with dynamic A-to-V limitation as a reversible aggravating factor. Left bundle branch area pacing addressed both atrioventricular and ventricular dyssynchrony.

AI.tldr: 92岁完全性房室传导阻滞患者双腔无导线起搏器植入9个月后出现起搏诱导性心肌病，升级为左束支区域起搏后QRS变窄、左室功能与二尖瓣反流改善。
AI.motivation: 双腔无导线起搏依赖逐搏的植入物间通信，心力衰竭相关的心脏几何变化可能使本就有限的通信储备进一步受限，导致房室同步性丢失；对于此类患者，如何在保留生理性起搏的同时纠正房室与心室不同步，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（JACC Case Rep）。对象为92岁女性，因完全性房室传导阻滞植入双腔无导线起搏器。9个月后出现心力衰竭，评估内容包括心房-心室（A-to-V）通信传输量、房室同步性、二尖瓣反流（功能性与舒张性）及左室射血分数；在利尿减容后复查上述指标，并在心力衰竭复发后升级为经静脉双腔起搏器联合左束支区域起搏。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法与定量终点。
AI.result: 减容后植入物间投影距离缩短，A-to-V传输量与房室同步性改善，舒张性二尖瓣反流消失；但尽管传输量保持且继续药物治疗，心力衰竭仍复发。升级为经静脉双腔起搏器联合左束支区域起搏后QRS波变窄，左室功能与二尖瓣反流改善。摘要未报告具体QRS时限、LVEF数值及P值。
AI.conclusion: 本例提示起搏诱导性心肌病可能是主要基质，而动态的A-to-V通信受限是可逆的加重因素；左束支区域起搏可同时纠正房室不同步与心室不同步。对双腔无导线起搏后出现心衰者，应评估通信储备与心室同步性，并考虑升级为传导系统起搏。结论受限于单例报告，尚需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：双腔无导线起搏依赖于逐搏的植入物间通信；心力衰竭相关的几何结构变化可能暴露有限的通信储备。

病例摘要：一名92岁女性完全性房室传导阻滞患者，在双腔无导线起搏器植入9个月后出现心力衰竭，表现为心房至心室（A至V）传输减少、房室分离、心室功能性及舒张期二尖瓣反流，以及左心室射血分数降低。减容治疗后，投影的装置间距离缩短，A至V传输和房室同步性改善，舒张期二尖瓣反流消失。尽管传输保持且继续药物治疗，心力衰竭仍复发。升级为经静脉双腔起搏器并采用左束支区域起搏后，QRS波变窄，左心室功能和二尖瓣反流改善。

讨论：起搏诱导的心肌病似乎是主要基础，动态A至V限制作为可逆的加重因素。左束支区域起搏解决了房室和心室不同步。

title: Junctional Rhythm and Atrial Ectopy Presenting as Chronic Abdominal Pain in Fontan Circulation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Rhythm disturbances may contribute to clinically significant hemodynamic compromise in patients with Fontan circulation, even without overt Fontan failure.

CASE SUMMARY: A 32-year-old woman with double-inlet left ventricle and total cavopulmonary connection presented with years of debilitating abdominal pain resulting in marked functional limitation. Extensive abdominal, hepatic, lymphatic, and cardiac investigations failed to identify a cause. Holter monitoring demonstrated predominant junctional rhythm and frequent atrial ectopy, whereas cardiopulmonary exercise testing revealed heart rate-dependent restoration of sinus rhythm with suppression of atrial ectopy. Invasive assessment showed that temporary atrial pacing suppressed ectopy and improved Fontan hemodynamics. Following AAIR pacemaker implantation, abdominal pain resolved completely and functional capacity improved.

DISCUSSION: This case illustrates that rhythm-related hemodynamic compromise may present with atypical extracardiac symptoms despite reassuring conventional investigations.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Chronic abdominal pain in patients with Fontan circulation may reflect arrhythmia-related hemodynamic compromise despite apparently stable Fontan physiology.

AI.tldr: 32岁Fontan循环患者因慢性腹痛就诊，Holter发现交界性心律伴频发房性早搏，植入AAIR起搏器后腹痛完全缓解、功能改善。
AI.motivation: Fontan循环患者即使无明显Fontan衰竭，心律失常也可能导致有临床意义的血流动力学障碍；既往常规腹部、肝脏、淋巴及心脏检查常无法解释非典型心外症状，此类表现易被漏诊。
AI.method: 单病例报告。对象为32岁女性，双入口左心室、全腔静脉肺动脉连接术后，表现为多年致残性腹痛及明显功能受限。行Holter、心肺运动试验及有创血流动力学评估；干预为临时心房起搏及随后植入AAIR起搏器；终点为腹痛症状与功能容量变化。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法及定量终点。
AI.result: 常规腹部、肝脏、淋巴及心脏检查均未发现病因。Holter示以交界性心律为主并频发房性早搏；心肺运动试验示心率依赖性窦性心律恢复并抑制房性早搏；有创评估示临时心房起搏可抑制异位搏动并改善Fontan血流动力学。植入AAIR起搏器后腹痛完全缓解，功能容量改善。摘要未报告具体血流动力学数值及P值。
AI.conclusion: Fontan循环患者的慢性腹痛可能反映心律失常相关血流动力学障碍，即使Fontan生理看似稳定；对常规检查不能解释的非典型症状应考虑节律评估，起搏治疗可能获益。但此为单例报告，结论外推受限，需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：在Fontan循环患者中，即使没有明显的Fontan衰竭，节律紊乱也可能导致具有临床意义的血流动力学受损。

病例摘要：一名32岁女性，患双入口左心室并已行全腔静脉肺动脉连接术，表现为多年使人衰弱的腹痛，导致显著的功能受限。广泛的腹部、肝脏、淋巴及心脏检查均未能明确病因。动态心电图监测显示以交界性心律为主并伴频发房性异位搏动，而心肺运动试验显示随心率变化窦性心律恢复且房性异位搏动被抑制。有创评估显示临时心房起搏可抑制异位搏动并改善Fontan血流动力学。植入AAIR起搏器后，腹痛完全缓解，功能能力改善。

讨论：本病例表明，节律相关的血流动力学受损可表现为非典型的心外症状，尽管常规检查结果令人安心。

要点信息：Fontan循环患者的慢性腹痛可能反映心律失常相关的血流动力学受损，尽管Fontan生理状态表面上稳定。

title: Transvenous Atrial Pacing Using Subclavian 3-Dimensional Electroanatomical Mapping in Lateral Tunnel Fontan With Sinus Arrest.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Bradyarrhythmias are common late complications after Fontan palliation. Transvenous pacing avoids the high-risk redo sternotomy required for epicardial leads but is technically challenging because of extensive surgical atrial scarring and low-voltage tissue.

CASE SUMMARY: A 39-year-old woman with a lateral tunnel Fontan and severe aortic regurgitation presented with heart failure secondary to bradyarrhythmia and sinus arrest. Using subclavian access, 3-dimensional electroanatomical mapping identified a discrete, viable island of native atrial tissue within an otherwise electrically inert baffle. A transvenous active-fixation pacemaker lead was successfully implanted at this site, restoring stable 1:1 atrioventricular conduction.

DISCUSSION: This case demonstrates that electroanatomical mapping can locate viable atrial tissue and guide lead implantation in complex Fontan atrial substrates. This technique allows for rapid identification of target lead implant sites through a single access point from the pacer pocket.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Three-dimensional mapping enables successful transvenous pacing in highly scarred Fontan atria. This technique allows for mapping and lead placement via the same surgical site.

AI.tldr: 一例39岁侧隧道Fontan术后窦性停搏患者，经锁骨下三维电解剖标测定位存活心房组织，成功植入经静脉主动固定起搏导线，恢复1:1房室传导。
AI.motivation: Fontan术后晚期心动过缓常见，经静脉起搏可避免心外膜导线所需的高风险再次开胸，但心房广泛瘢痕和低电压组织使导线植入困难，既往缺乏有效定位手段。
AI.method: 病例报告。39岁女性，侧隧道Fontan术后，严重主动脉瓣反流，因心动过缓及窦性停搏导致心力衰竭。经锁骨下入路行三维电解剖标测，在电惰性挡板内识别出离散的存活心房组织岛，于该处植入经静脉主动固定起搏导线。终点为导线植入成功及房室传导恢复。
AI.result: 三维电解剖标测成功定位存活心房组织，经静脉主动固定起搏导线植入成功，恢复稳定的1:1房室传导。摘要未报告具体标测参数、起搏阈值及随访数据。
AI.conclusion: 三维电解剖标测可指导复杂Fontan心房基质中的经静脉起搏导线植入，通过起搏器囊袋单一切口即可完成标测与导线放置。该技术为Fontan术后心动过缓患者提供了避免再次开胸的微创选择，但结论基于单例病例，需更多研究验证其可重复性和长期效果。

summary_zh:
背景：心动过缓性心律失常是Fontan姑息术后常见的晚期并发症。经静脉起搏可避免心外膜导线所需的高风险再次胸骨切开术，但由于广泛的外科心房瘢痕和低电压组织，该技术在操作上具有挑战性。

病例摘要：一名39岁女性，患有侧隧道Fontan和重度主动脉瓣反流，因心动过缓性心律失常和窦性停搏继发心力衰竭就诊。采用锁骨下入路，三维电解剖标测在电惰性的挡板内识别出一处离散的、有活力的原生心房组织岛。在该部位成功植入经静脉主动固定起搏器导线，恢复了稳定的1：1房室传导。

讨论：本病例表明，电解剖标测可以定位有活力的心房组织，并指导复杂Fontan心房基质中的导线植入。该技术允许通过起搏器囊袋的单一入路快速识别目标导线植入部位。

要点：三维标测使得在高瘢痕化的Fontan心房中成功进行经静脉起搏成为可能。该技术允许通过同一手术部位进行标测和导线放置。

title: Novel Transvenous Approach for Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Implantation in a Patient With Fontan Circulation: Trans-Left Pulmonary Artery-Left Atrium.
summary:
BACKGROUND: After Fontan palliation, direct venous access to the ventricle is eliminated, complicating implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) placement.

FIH/EARLY REPORTS SUMMARY: A 34-year-old status-post lateral tunnel Fontan presented with syncope. He was found to have high-grade atrioventricular block and fractured epicardial leads. He was recommended an ICD with severely depressed single right ventricle function but was not an epicardial candidate because of multiple prior sternotomies and recurrent chest wall abscesses. Despite balloon angioplasty of the transbaffle puncture, a sheath for ICD placement could not be advanced. A trans-left pulmonary artery to left atrial (LPA-LA) puncture was performed at the left pulmonary artery/Fontan conduit junction above the left atrium roof to implant the right ventricle ICD lead.

DISCUSSION: Transpulmonary LPA-LA is a feasible option for ICD lead implantation in patients with Fontan who are not candidates for epicardial leads.

NOVELTY: This is the first report of transpulmonary LPA-LA puncture for ventricular lead placement in Fontan circulation.

AI.tldr: 首例经左肺动脉-左心房途径为Fontan循环患者植入ICD右室导线，术后未报告并发症。
AI.motivation: Fontan术后静脉通路无法直接到达心室，心外膜导线因多次开胸和胸壁感染不可行，亟需替代途径植入ICD。
AI.method: 病例报告：34岁侧隧道Fontan术后患者，因晕厥发现高度房室传导阻滞及心外膜导线断裂，单右心室功能严重减低，推荐ICD。经球囊扩张穿板穿刺仍无法送入鞘管，遂在左肺动脉/Fontan管道交界处行经左肺动脉-左心房穿刺植入右室ICD导线。
AI.result: 摘要未报告手术成功率、导线参数、围术期并发症及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 经肺动脉左肺动脉-左心房途径是Fontan循环患者心外膜导线不可行时植入ICD导线的可行选择，为首次报道；但仅为单例经验，安全性和长期效果需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：Fontan 姑息术后，直接经静脉途径进入心室被消除，使植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）的放置变得复杂。

FIH/早期报告摘要：一名 34 岁侧隧道 Fontan 术后患者因晕厥就诊。发现其存在高度房室传导阻滞和心外膜导线断裂。建议植入 ICD，其单右心室功能严重减低，但由于多次既往胸骨切开术和反复胸壁脓肿，不适合心外膜途径。尽管对经挡板穿刺进行了球囊血管成形术，仍无法推进用于 ICD 放置的鞘管。在左心房顶上方左肺动脉/Fontan 管道交界处行经左肺动脉至左心房（LPA-LA）穿刺，以植入右心室 ICD 导线。

讨论：经肺动脉 LPA-LA 途径对于不适合心外膜导线的 Fontan 患者，是植入 ICD 导线的一种可行选择。

新颖性：这是首例报告经肺动脉 LPA-LA 穿刺在 Fontan 循环中放置心室导线。

title: Assessing the inclusion of frailty scores in either the methodology or results of clinical intervention trials of heart failure: A scoping review.
summary: Chronic heart failure is highly prevalent in older adults, in whom frailty is common and associated with poorer outcomes. Despite advances in guideline-directed medical therapy, concerns regarding tolerability and polypharmacy contribute to under-utilization in frail patients. This scoping review aimed to map the existing evidence on how clinical interventional trials of heart failure management have incorporated frailty, specifically, whether trials have (i) stratified outcomes according to frailty status and/or (ii) adjusted treatment strategies based on frailty. We searched MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL and ClinicalTrials.gov for interventional trials of heart failure published up to August 2025 that incorporated frailty using validated assessment tools. Eligible studies stratified outcomes by frailty status and/or adjusted interventions based on frailty. Data were extracted and a narrative synthesis was conducted. Ten studies met the inclusion criteria. Seven were post-hoc analyses of randomized controlled trials, two were prespecified analyses, and one was a randomized controlled trial. Two studies evaluated exercise-based interventions, one on implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, and the remainder on pharmacological-based therapies. Nine studies used the Rockwood cumulative deficit approach to measure frailty, although the parameters used varied between studies. Available secondary analyses suggest preserved efficacy across frailty groups for most pharmacological interventions, whereas other modalities did not show convincing improvements in heart failure-specific outcomes among frail patients. Primary evidence of heart failure interventions incorporating frailty remains limited, with a large bulk of the evidence available being retrospective. Although several reported pharmacological interventions appear to have preserved efficacy across frailty levels, some of these therapies were not recommended in current guidelines, and heterogeneity in frailty measurement reduced the confidence of conclusions drawn. The gaps identified in this review highlight the need for further primary evidence that incorporates frailty, plus a standardized holistic method of measuring frailty in heart failure patients.

title: Arrhythmogenic Left Ventricular Cardiomyopathy Associated with MYH7 Mutation.
summary:
Arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy (ALVC) is an increasingly recognized phenotype within the spectrum of arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathies, historically associated with mutations in desmosomal genes. However, emerging evidence suggests that non-desmosomal variants may also contribute to this disease entity. We report the case of a 58-year-old man with atrial fibrillation, nonischemic cardiomyopathy, and prior cryptogenic stroke who presented with progressive exertional dyspnea, chest discomfort, and palpitations. Coronary angiography excluded obstructive coronary artery disease. Transthoracic echocardiography demonstrated reduced left ventricular systolic function with features suggestive of infiltrative cardiomyopathy. A technetium-99m pyrophosphate scan was negative for transthyretin amyloidosis. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging ultimately revealed extensive mid-wall late gadolinium enhancement involving multiple basal and mid-left ventricular segments in a nonischemic distribution, consistent with myocardial fibrosis. Comprehensive genetic testing identified a heterozygous pathogenic MYH7 variant (p.Arg723Cys), fulfilling the genetic component of the Padua criteria for ALVC. Rhythm control was achieved with electrical cardioversion and maintained with dofetilide, while heart failure was managed with guideline-directed medical therapy. In view of the extensive myocardial fibrosis and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, primary prevention with an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was recommended. This case expands the phenotypic spectrum of MYH7-associated cardiomyopathy and highlights the critical role of multimodal imaging and genetic testing in establishing the diagnosis of ALVC and guiding risk stratification.

CLINICAL IMPACT: Arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy (ALVC) remains an underrecognized and diagnostically challenging phenotype of arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This case describes a potential association between the pathogenic MYH7 p.Arg723Cys variant and ALVC, expanding the phenotypic spectrum of MYH7-associated cardiomyopathy beyond its more established associations with hypertrophic and dilated cardiomyopathy. The case highlights the complementary roles of cardiac magnetic resonance imaging and genetic testing in identifying ALVC when conventional evaluation is inconclusive. Recognition of extensive myocardial fibrosis together with a pathogenic genetic variant may also provide important information for arrhythmic risk stratification, consideration of primary-prevention implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy, genetic counseling, and cascade testing of first-degree relatives.

title: Exploring the Potential Mechanisms Linking Bisphenol A Exposure to Atrial Fibrillation: An Integrated Multi-Dimensional Analysis from Network Toxicology to In Vivo Validation.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common clinical arrhythmia with complex pathogenesis and limited therapeutic options. The pro-arrhythmic effect of environmental endocrine disruptor bisphenol A (BPA) remains unclear. This study integrated network toxicology, Mendelian randomization (MR), molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, single-cell transcriptomics and in vivo rat experiments to construct a multi-dimensional evidence chain for exploring BPA-mediated AF mechanisms and key intervention targets. We screened 206 shared targets of BPA and AF, which were enriched in endocrine resistance, phosphoinositide 3-kinase-protein kinase B, and lipid-metabolism pathways. Protein-protein interaction and two-sample MR analyses, supported by genetic evidence, suggested cystatin C (CST3) as a potential risk factor for AF, while glutathione S-transferase A1 (GSTA1) and placental growth factor (PGF) served as potential protective factors. Molecular docking confirmed favorable binding activities between BPA and core targets (binding energy < -5.0 kcal/mol), and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations verified stable complex conformations under physiological conditions. Single-cell transcriptomics revealed cell-type-specific expression of target genes: CST3 in immune and stromal cells, GSTA1 in smooth muscle cells and fibroblasts, and PGF predominantly in smooth muscle cells. Further experiments in Sprague-Dawley rats demonstrated that BPA exposure increased AF inducibility, upregulated atrial CST3, down-regulated GSTA1 and PGF, and aggravated atrial fibrosis and inflammatory infiltration. Collectively, BPA may promote AF by interfering with the functions of CST3, GSTA1, and PGF. This study provides evidence for the pro-arrhythmic effects of environmental pollutants and theoretical references for targeted prevention and treatment of AF.
